A manufacturer agreed in writing with a beverage company to provide all the flavor syrup the beverage company's soft drink requires for the next three years. The beverage company's soft drink contains a small amount of caffeine. The manufacturer promised in the contract to "promote in good faith the sale of the soft drink," but the contract said nothing about restrictions on the products that the manufacturer could produce. The contract also stated that it was the "complete and final agreement" between the manufacturer and the beverage company.
Six months later, the manufacturer agreed with a competitor of the beverage company to produce flavor syrup for its caffeine-free beverages.
If the beverage company sues the manufacturer for breach of their contract, which of the following facts, if established, would most strengthen the beverage company's case?

A landowner entered into a written agreement to sell his land for a fraction of its fair market value. The landowner was subsequently adjudicated to be incompetent, and his son was appointed his guardian. When the landowner's son learned of the agreement, acting as his father's court-appointed guardian, he sought to have the sale set aside. The buyer argued that the agreement was enforceable because it was totally integrated and in writing. The son argued that, based on prior conversations between the landowner and the buyer in which the landowner said that he was an alien from a distant planet, the buyer knew or should have known that the landowner was suffering from dementia.
Will the court likely admit evidence of the prior conversations between the landowner and the buyer?

questions.question:
Responding to a county's written advertisement for bids, a tire company was the successful bidder for the sale of tires to a county for its vehicles. The company and the county entered into a signed, written agreement that specified, "It is agreed that the company will deliver all tires required by this agreement to the county, in accordance with the attached bid form and specifications, for a one-year period beginning September 1, 2019." Attached to the agreement was a copy of the bid form and specifications. In the written advertisement to which the company had responded, but not in the bid form, the county had stated, "Multiple awards may be issued if they are in the best interests of the county." No definite quantity of tires to be bought by the county from the company was specified in any of these documents.
In January 2020, the company learned that the county was buying some of its tires from one of the company's competitors. Contending that the tire company–county agreement was a requirements contract, the company sued the county for the damages caused by the county's purchase of some of its tires from the competitor.
If the county's defense is to offer proof of the advertisement concerning the possibility of multiple awards, should the court admit the evidence?

choices.a: No, because it would make the contract illusory.
choices.b: No, because of the parol evidence rule.
choices.c: Yes, because the advertisement was in writing.
choices.d: Yes, because the provision in the written agreement, "all tires required by this agreement," is ambiguous.

为回应某县的书面招标广告，一家轮胎公司成功中标，向该县销售其车辆用轮胎。该公司与该县签订了一份书面协议，其中规定：“双方同意，自2019年9月1日起为期一年，公司将根据所附的投标表格和规格说明，向该县交付本协议所要求的所有轮胎。” 协议附有投标表格和规格说明的副本。在该公司回应的书面广告中（但不在投标表格中），该县曾声明：“如果符合该县的最佳利益，可能会授予多个合同。” 这些文件中均未明确规定该县将从该公司购买轮胎的确切数量。

2020年1月，该公司得知该县正在从其一个竞争对手那里购买部分轮胎。公司主张其与该县的协议是一份需求合同（requirements contract），因此就该县从竞争对手处购买部分轮胎所造成的损失起诉了该县。

如果该县的抗辩是提供关于可能授予多个合同的广告作为证据，法院是否应采纳该证据？
options:
A. No, because it would make the contract illusory.
不应采纳，因为这会使合同变为虚幻合同。

B. No, because of the parol evidence rule.
不应采纳，因为有口头证据规则（parol evidence rule）的限制。

C. Yes, because the advertisement was in writing.
应采纳，因为该广告是书面形式。

D. Yes, because the provision in the written agreement, "all tires required by this agreement," is ambiguous.
应采纳，因为书面协议中的条款“本协议所要求的所有轮胎”含义模糊。
data.explanation:
Exceptions to parol evidence rule Evidence of prior or contemporaneous oral or written agreement is admissible to establish:
  • whether writing is integrated and, if so, completely or partially
  • meaning of ambiguous term
  • defense to formation or enforcement (eg, fraud, duress, mistake)
  • ground for granting or denying remedy (eg, rescission, reformation)
  • subsequent contract modifications
  • condition precedent to effectiveness

Under the parol evidence rule , evidence of prior or contemporaneous agreements or negotiations is not admissible to contradict the terms of an integrated contract. A contract is integrated when (1) it is in writing and (2) it embodies the final expression of the parties' intent regarding the contract's subject matter (as seen here). But even when a contract is integrated, such evidence is admissible to interpret an ambiguous contract term.

Here, the provision in the written agreement, "all tires required by this agreement," is ambiguous: it could mean as many tires as the county chooses to order during the one-year contract term OR as many tires as the county actually requires during that period (making this a requirements contract). Therefore, evidence of the written advertisement, which stated that the county could issue multiple tire awards, is admissible to determine whether the contract was, in fact, a requirements contract (Choice B).

(Choice A) Where a promising party has discretion whether to perform at all, its promise is illusory. Because the county's evidence indicates that "all tires required by this agreement" means "as many tires as the county chooses to order," it could make the contract illusory if admitted. But this is not a reason to exclude the evidence.

(Choice C) The fact that the advertisement was in writing is irrelevant. Any evidence (oral or written) can be used to interpret the meaning of an ambiguous contract term.

Educational objective: The parol evidence rule does not bar evidence of a prior or contemporaneous agreement, and such evidence is admissible when it is used to
  • establish the meaning of an ambiguous contract term.


选项正确率统计：A选项 6%，B选项 28%，C选项 5%，D选项 59%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

口头证据规则的例外 先于或同期达成的口头或书面协议的证据可以被采纳，以确定：
  • 书面文件是否为完整协议，如果是，是完全完整还是部分完整
  • 模糊条款的含义
  • 合同成立或执行的抗辩理由（例如，欺诈、胁迫、错误）
  • 批准或拒绝救济的理由（例如，撤销、修正）
  • 后续的合同修订
  • 合同生效的先决条件

根据口头证据规则（parol evidence rule），任何先于或同期达成的协议或协商的证据，如果与一份完整合同（integrated contract）的条款相矛盾，则不予采纳。当一份合同 (1) 是书面形式并且 (2) 体现了双方就合同标的物达成的最终意向时（如此处所示），该合同即为一份完整合同。但是，即使合同是完整的，这类证据在用于解释模糊的合同条款时，也是可以采纳的。

在此案中，书面协议中的条款“本协议所要求的所有轮胎”是模糊的：它可能指该县在一年合同期内选择订购的任意数量的轮胎，也可能指该县在此期间实际需要的所有轮胎（这将使其成为一份需求合同）。因此，该书面广告（其中声明该县可以授予多个轮胎合同）的证据可以被采纳，以确定该合同实际上是否是一份需求合同（选项B）。

（选项A）如果承诺方有完全的酌情决定权来决定是否履行，其承诺是虚幻的。由于该县的证据表明“本协议所要求的所有轮胎”意为“该县选择订购的任意数量的轮胎”，如果采纳该证据，可能会使合同变为虚幻合同。但这并非排除该证据的理由。

（选项C）该广告是书面形式这一事实无关紧要。任何证据（口头或书面）都可以用来解释模糊合同条款的含义。

教学目标：口头证据规则不禁止采纳先前或同期的协议证据，当该证据被用于
  • 确定模糊合同条款的含义时，该证据可以被采纳。


References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 214 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when parol evidence is admissible to explain meaning of ambiguous term).

MBE 考点解析

Contract Law: Parol Evidence Rule

核心考点：口头证据规则的例外

本题考察的是口头证据规则 (Parol Evidence Rule, PER) 的一个关键例外：解释歧义 (Interpretation of Ambiguity)。

基本规则：
如果双方签订了完整整合 (Fully Integrated) 的书面合同，通常不允许引入先前的口头或书面证据来反驳 (Contradict) 合同条款。
关键例外 (本题考点)：
即使合同是完整的，如果合同中的某个条款含义模糊 (Ambiguous)，法院允许引入外部证据（Parol Evidence）来解释 (Explain) 该条款的含义，以探究双方的真实意图。
案情深度分析
1. 争议焦点：
合同中的条款写道：“company will deliver all tires required by this agreement”（公司将交付本协议所要求的所有轮胎）。
2. 为什么存在歧义 (Ambiguity)？
这句话有两种合理的解释：
  • 解释 A (需求合同)：指该县在一年内实际需要的所有轮胎（Exclusivity/排他性）。
  • 解释 B (非排他性合同)：指该县根据本协议决定订购的那些轮胎（即“本协议”本身产生的需求，而非该县的全部需求）。
由于仅凭合同文本无法确定是哪种意思，因此存在歧义。
3. 证据的作用：
该县希望引入的“招标广告”中提到“可能授予多个合同 (Multiple awards may be issued)”。这条证据不是为了推翻合同，而是为了证明双方当时对“required by this agreement”的理解是非排他性的（即支持解释 B）。
正确答案：选项 D

应采纳，因为书面协议中的条款“本协议所要求的所有轮胎”含义模糊。

这是对法律规则的直接应用。一旦法院认定合同用语有歧义，口头证据规则就不再阻止外部证据的进入。广告作为先前的书面文件，可以帮助陪审团理解双方在签约时对那个模糊短语的真实意图。

为什么排除其他选项？
选项 A 错误
"No, because it would make the contract illusory."
理由： 即使采纳证据后证明该县没有义务购买固定数量的轮胎（可能导致合同因缺乏对价而成为虚幻合同），这也不是拒绝采纳证据的理由。证据规则关注的是“能否看证据”，而不是“证据会导致什么后果”。
选项 B 错误
"No, because of the parol evidence rule."
理由： 这是一个典型的陷阱。考生看到“书面合同”和“先前证据”，容易机械地套用 PER 规则进行排除。但必须识别出“歧义例外”。PER 不禁止解释歧义的证据。
选项 C 错误
"Yes, because the advertisement was in writing."
理由： 证据的形式（书面 vs. 口头）不是决定性因素。PER 限制的是“先前的”证据，无论口头还是书面。如果条款不模糊，先前的书面广告同样会被排除。
💡 MBE 备考锦囊：
在处理 Parol Evidence Rule 题目时，请遵循以下两步法：
  1. 看目的： 证据是用来反驳 (Contradict) 还是解释 (Explain)？
  2. 找歧义： 如果合同条款有多种理解方式（Ambiguous），PER 的大门就会打开，允许引入外部证据来澄清含义。
记住：Ambiguity = Admissibility (有歧义即有可采性)。

questions.question:
A radio manufacturer and a retailer, after extensive negotiations, entered into a final, written agreement in which the manufacturer agreed to sell and the retailer agreed to buy all of its requirements of radios, estimated at 20 units per month, during the period from January 1, 2017 to December 31, 2019, at a price of $50 per unit. A dispute arose in late December 2019, when the retailer returned 25 undefective radios to the manufacturer for full credit after the manufacturer had refused to extend the contract for a second three-year period.
In an action by the radio manufacturer against the retailer for damages due to return of the 25 radios, the manufacturer introduces the written agreement, which expressly permitted the retailer to return defective radios for credit but was silent as to return of undefective radios for credit. The retailer seeks to introduce evidence that during the three years of the agreement it had returned, for various reasons, 125 undefective radios, for which the manufacturer had granted full credit. The manufacturer objects to the admissibility of this evidence.
How will the trial court probably rule as to the admissibility of the evidence proffered by the retailer?

choices.a: Admissible, because course-of-performance evidence, when available, is considered the best indication of what the parties intended the writing to mean.
choices.b: Admissible, because the evidence supports an agreement that is not within the relevant statute of frauds.
choices.c: Inadmissible, because the evidence is barred by the parol evidence rule.
choices.d: Inadmissible, because the express terms of the agreement control when those terms are inconsistent with the course of performance.

一家收音机制造商和一家零售商，经过广泛协商，达成了一份最终书面协议。协议中，制造商同意出售，零售商同意购买其所需的所有收音机，预计每月20台，期限为2017年1月1日至2019年12月31日，单价为50美元。2019年12月底，在制造商拒绝将合同续签第二个三年期后，零售商将25台无瑕疵的收音机退还给制造商要求全额退款，由此产生了争议。

在收音机制造商就退还25台收音机向零售商提起的损害赔偿诉讼中，制造商出示了书面协议，该协议明确允许零售商退还有瑕疵的收音机以获得退款，但对于退还无瑕疵的收音机以获得退款则未作规定。零售商试图引入证据，证明在协议的三年期间，其曾因各种原因退回125台无瑕疵的收音机，而制造商均给予了全额退款。制造商反对该证据的可采性。

初审法院很可能会如何裁定零售商所提供证据的可采性？
options:
A. Admissible, because course-of-performance evidence, when available, is considered the best indication of what the parties intended the writing to mean.
可采信，因为履约过程（course-of-performance）证据在可用时，被认为是双方书面协议意图的最佳诠释。

B. Admissible, because the evidence supports an agreement that is not within the relevant statute of frauds.
可采信，因为该证据支持了一项不在相关欺诈法（statute of frauds）范围内的协议。

C. Inadmissible, because the evidence is barred by the parol evidence rule.
不可采信，因为该证据被口头证据规则（parol evidence rule）所禁止。

D. Inadmissible, because the express terms of the agreement control when those terms are inconsistent with the course of performance.
不可采信，因为当协议的明示条款与履约过程不一致时，以明示条款为准。
data.explanation:
UCC parol evidence rule


DescriptionPriority of evidence
InadmissiblePrior/contemporaneous agreements that contradict written contractExpress terms always control
Course of performanceAdmissibleSequence of conduct under contract involving repeated occasions for performanceCourse of performance > course of dealing & trade usage
Course of dealingSequence of conduct pertaining to previous contractsCourse of dealing > trade usage
Trade usageRegular practice or method of dealing in that particular business/industryN/A

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code



Contracts for the sale of goods (eg, radios) are governed by Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC). Under the UCC's parol evidence rule, the express terms of a final, written contract cannot be contradicted by evidence of inconsistent prior or contemporaneous agreements. But when a contract is silent on an issue, its terms can be supplemented with evidence of a course of performance - ie, a sequence of conduct under a contract that involves repeated occasions for performance.

Here, the radio manufacturer and the retailer entered a final, written requirements contract for the sale of radios. Near the end of the contract, the retailer returned 25 undefective radios for credit, as it had previously done with 125 undefective radios. The contract expressly permitted the return of defective radios, but it was silent as to the return of undefective radios (Choice D). Therefore, evidence of this course of performance is admissible since it is the best indication of what the parties intended the writing to mean (Choice C).

(Choice B) Under the statute of frauds, certain types of contracts - eg, contracts for the sale of goods greater than $500 - are only enforceable if they are written and signed by the party against whom enforcement is sought. But here, the contract is within the statute of frauds since it called for the sale of an estimated 20 radios per month, at $50 per radio, for 36 months (ie, greater than $500).

Educational objective: The parol evidence rule prohibits evidence of inconsistent prior agreements that contradict a final, written contract. But when a contract is silent on an issue, its terms can be explained or supplemented with evidence of a course of performance - ie, a sequence of conduct under a contract involving repeated occasions for performance.

UCC 口头证据规则


描述证据的优先顺序
不可采信与书面合同相矛盾的先前/同期协议明示条款始终优先
履约过程 (Course of performance)可采信合同项下涉及重复履行机会的一系列行为履约过程 > 交易过程 & 行业惯例
交易过程 (Course of dealing)与先前合同相关的一系列行为交易过程 > 行业惯例
行业惯例 (Trade usage)特定商业/行业中的常规做法或交易方法不适用

UCC = 《统一商法典》(Uniform Commercial Code)



货物（例如，收音机）销售合同受《统一商法典》(UCC) 第二条管辖。根据UCC的口头证据规则，最终书面合同的明示条款不得与不一致的先前或同期协议的证据相矛盾。但是，当合同对某个问题未作规定时，其条款可以用履约过程的证据来补充——即合同项下涉及重复履行机会的一系列行为。

在本案中，收音机制造商和零售商就收音机销售签订了一份最终的书面需求合同。在合同即将结束时，零售商退回了25台无瑕疵的收音机要求退款，正如其先前处理125台无瑕疵收音机时所做的那样。该合同明确允许退回有瑕疵的收音机，但对于退回无瑕疵的收音机则未作规定（选项D）。因此，这一履约过程的证据是可采信的，因为它是双方书面协议意图的最佳诠释（选项A）。

（选项B） 根据欺诈法，某些类型的合同——例如，价值超过500美元的货物销售合同——只有在由被要求强制执行的一方书面签署后才可强制执行。但在本案中，该合同属于欺诈法的管辖范围，因为它要求在36个月内每月销售约20台收音机，每台50美元（即总额超过500美元）。

教学目标： 口头证据规则禁止引入与最终书面合同相矛盾的不一致的先前协议的证据。但是，当合同对某个问题未作规定时，其条款可以通过履约过程的证据来解释或补充——即合同项下涉及重复履行机会的一系列行为。

References

U.C.C. § 2-202 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (parol evidence rule).

MBE 考点解析

UCC 合同解释与履约过程

本题考察的核心是 《统一商法典》(UCC) 下的合同解释规则，特别是如何利用履约过程 (Course of Performance) 来补充书面合同的条款。

正确答案：A
可采信，因为履约过程证据是双方意图的最佳诠释。
⚖️ 法律依据：UCC Parol Evidence Rule

根据 UCC § 2-202（口头证据规则），虽然最终的书面协议不能被先前或同期的口头协议所反驳，但它可以通过以下三种证据进行解释或补充：

证据类型 (英文) 定义 优先级
Course of Performance
(履约过程)		 双方在当前合同下的重复行为 1 (最高)
Course of Dealing
(交易过程)		 双方在过往合同中的行为 2
Usage of Trade
(行业惯例)		 该行业的普遍做法 3
🔍 案件深度解析

1. 合同的“沉默”并非“矛盾”
书面合同明确允许退回“有瑕疵”(defective) 的收音机，但对于“无瑕疵”(undefective) 的收音机只字未提 (Silent)。这并不意味着禁止退回无瑕疵产品，只是留下了解释的空间。

2. 履约过程 (Course of Performance) 的力量
在本合同履行的三年期间，零售商退回了 125 台无瑕疵收音机，且制造商全额退款。这种在当前合同项下反复发生的行为，构成了“履约过程”。

3. 结论
根据 UCC，履约过程是判断双方对合同条款实际理解的最佳证据。既然合同对此点沉默，法院会允许引入该证据来证明双方实际上达成了一种默契：无瑕疵产品也可以退货。

❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 C (口头证据规则)：
错误。口头证据规则 (Parol Evidence Rule) 主要禁止引入与书面合同矛盾的先前协议。它并不禁止引入后续的履约行为来解释合同，也不禁止在合同沉默时进行补充。

选项 D (明示条款优先)：
错误。虽然明示条款 (Express Terms) 确实优先于履约过程，但前提是两者发生冲突。本案中，合同是“沉默”的（没说可以，也没说不可以），因此履约过程是用来补充而非反驳明示条款。

选项 B (欺诈法)：
错误。虽然这涉及货物销售（超过$500），属于欺诈法 (Statute of Frauds) 范围，但这与证据是否可采信以解释合同条款无关。这是一个干扰项。

🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理 UCC Article 2 的题目时，请记住证据的优先等级金字塔：

  1. Express Terms (白纸黑字的条款)
  2. Course of Performance (现在的做法)
  3. Course of Dealing (以前的做法)
  4. Usage of Trade (别人的做法)

只要不与上一级发生直接冲突，下一级的证据通常都是可采信 (Admissible) 的。

Exceptions to parol evidence rule Evidence of prior or contemporaneous oral or written agreement is admissible to establish:
  • whether writing is integrated and, if so, completely or partially
  • meaning of ambiguous term
  • defense to formation or enforcement (eg, fraud, duress, mistake)
  • ground for granting or denying remedy (eg, rescission, reformation)
  • subsequent contract modifications
  • condition precedent to effectiveness


The UCC parol evidence rule generally bars evidence of a prior written agreement (or contemporaneous oral agreement) to contradict the terms of an integrated writing. But the parol evidence rule does not bar such evidence, and such evidence is always admissible, when it is used to clarify the meaning of an ambiguous contract term. This is true regardless of whether the contract is completely or partially integrated.

Here, the written contract failed to state whether an assignment of the buyer's insurance claim was included in the term "trade-in allowance." The contract contained a merger clause, which indicates that the contract was completely integrated.† But the merger clause does not bar evidence to explain what the parties meant by "trade-in allowance." Therefore, the court should admit the evidence that the parties agreed during their negotiations for the new car that the dealer was entitled to the insurance payment (Choice B).

†A merger clause is strong, but not conclusive, evidence that a contract is completely integrated.

(Choice A) A buyer's mere acceptance of goods does not waive its potential claims against a seller.

(Choice C) Evidence used to establish a defense to formation or enforceability of a contract (eg, fraud) is excepted from the parol evidence rule. But there is no indication of fraud in this case, so this exception is irrelevant.

Educational objective: Even when a contract is completely integrated (eg, as evidenced by a merger clause), the parol evidence rule does not bar evidence to clarify the meaning of an ambiguous contract term.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

口头证据规则的例外情况 在先的或同期的口头或书面协议的证据，在下述情况下可以被采纳以兹证明：
  • 书面文件是否为一份整合协议，以及如果是，是完全整合还是部分整合
  • 模糊条款的含义
  • 对合同成立或强制执行的抗辩（例如，欺诈、胁迫、错误）
  • 授予或拒绝救济的理由（例如，合同撤销、合同变更）
  • 后续的合同修订
  • 合同生效的先决条件


UCC口头证据规则通常禁止采纳在先书面协议（或同期口头协议）的证据，以与一份整合协议的条款相矛盾。但是，当证据被用来澄清一个模糊合同条款的含义时，口头证据规则并不禁止此类证据，且此类证据总是可以被采纳的。无论合同是完全整合还是部分整合，这都成立。

在本案中，书面合同未说明买方的保险索赔转让是否包含在“折价补贴”这一术语中。该合同包含一个合并条款，表明该合同是一份完全整合的协议。† 但合并条款并不禁止用证据来解释双方对“折价补贴”一词的意图。因此，法院应采纳该证据，即双方在新车谈判期间同意经销商有权获得保险赔付款（选项B）。

†合并条款是合同完全整合的有力证据，但非决定性证据。

（选项A）买方仅接受货物的行为并不构成其放弃对卖方的潜在索赔。

（选项C）用于证明对合同成立或可执行性进行抗辩（如欺诈）的证据是口头证据规则的例外。但在本案中没有欺诈的迹象，因此该例外不适用。

教学目标：即使合同是完全整合的（例如，有合并条款证明），口头证据规则也不禁止为澄清模糊合同条款含义而提出的证据。

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Parol Evidence Rule
核心考点：口头证据规则的解释例外

即使合同包含合并条款 (Merger Clause)，表明合同是完全整合的 (Completely Integrated)，口头证据规则 (Parol Evidence Rule, PER) 依然允许引入外部证据来解释 (Explain) 或澄清合同中模棱两可的术语含义，只要该证据不与书面条款直接相矛盾。

适用法律：UCC § 2-202 (因涉及汽车买卖)

逻辑推演

本题的关键在于区分“矛盾 (Contradict)”与“解释 (Explain)”。

1. 合同现状：买卖双方签署了一份包含合并条款的书面合同。这意味着我们通常不能引入先前的口头协议来增加或改变合同条款。

2. 争议点：合同中规定了“$7,000 的折价补贴 (Trade-in Allowance)”。但是，这个术语的具体范围是不明确的。它仅仅是指旧车本身的金属价值？还是包含了与旧车相关的权利（如保险索赔权）？

3. 证据的作用：经销商提供的口头证据（谈判期间同意转让保险金）并不是要改变 $7,000 这个数字，也不是要否定折价的事实。相反，它是为了定义“折价补贴”这一模糊术语的具体构成。

4. 结论：根据 UCC 和普通法，解释歧义条款的外部证据总是可采纳的 (Admissible)，合并条款无法阻止此类证据。

选项辨析
正确 D 解释含义： 这是正确答案。合并条款虽然能阻止引入“额外条款”，但不能阻止引入证据来解释双方对现有术语（"trade-in allowance"）的意图。
错误 B 合并条款的误区： 这是最具迷惑性的干扰项。考生容易看到“Merger Clause”就机械地认为所有外部证据都被禁止。实际上，合并条款禁止的是与书面内容相矛盾或补充（如果是完全整合）的证据，但绝不禁止解释性证据。
错误 A 接受货物： 根据 UCC，买方接受货物并不意味着放弃对违约或其他索赔的权利。这与证据可采性无关。
错误 C 欺诈例外： 虽然欺诈确实是 PER 的例外，但本题事实中没有任何迹象表明存在欺诈行为（Fraud）。不能凭空假设存在欺诈。
💡 MBE 实战技巧：
当你看到题目中出现书面合同 (Written Contract) + 合并条款 (Merger Clause) + 先前的口头商议 (Prior Oral Agreement) 时：
  1. 首先判断该证据是否试图改变或反驳明确的条款？（如果是，通常不可采纳）。
  2. 其次判断该证据是否试图解释一个可能模糊的术语？（如果是，通常可采纳，选 D 类选项）。
记住：Ambiguity (歧义) 是打开口头证据大门的钥匙。

A power company operated a 100-turbine wind farm. The turbines began experiencing mechanical problems and required 10 new gearboxes in order to produce electricity at full capacity. Because the manufacturer of the gearboxes was unable to guarantee speedy delivery, the power company contacted a separate shipping company. The two companies signed a fully integrated writing in which the shipping company promised to deliver the gearboxes by June 1. Before the agreement was executed, the power company told the shipping company, "If you do not deliver the gearboxes by June 1, we will be unable to produce enough electricity to meet our existing contractual obligation to a nearby town."
The shipping company was inexcusably late in delivering the gearboxes, and, as a result, the power company breached its contract with the nearby town and was found liable for damages. The power company then sued the shipping company, which was found to have breached its contract with the power company. At a hearing on damages, the shipping company now seeks to exclude any evidence of the conversation regarding timely delivery.
How will the court likely rule?

choices.a: Admit the evidence as proof of a collateral agreement.
choices.b: Admit the evidence as proof of the foreseeability of consequential damages.
choices.c: Exclude the evidence as a prior oral agreement even if it is consistent with the terms of the parties' written agreement.
choices.d: Exclude the evidence on the basis that the parties' written agreement was a fully integrated contract.

一家电力公司运营着一个拥有100台涡轮机的风力发电场。这些涡轮机开始出现机械问题，需要10个新齿轮箱才能满负荷发电。由于齿轮箱的制造商无法保证快速交货，电力公司联系了一家独立的运输公司。两家公司签署了一份完全整合的书面文件，其中运输公司承诺在6月1日之前交付齿轮箱。在协议执行前，电力公司告知运输公司，“如果你们未能在6月1日前交付齿轮箱，我们将无法生产足够的电力来履行我们与邻近城镇的现有合同义务。”

运输公司在交付齿轮箱方面无故迟延，结果导致电力公司违反了其与邻近城镇的合同，并被裁定承担损害赔偿责任。电力公司随后起诉了运输公司，运输公司被认定违反了其与电力公司的合同。在关于损害赔偿的听证会上，运输公司现在试图排除任何有关及时交付的谈话证据。

法院可能会如何裁决？
options:
A. Admit the evidence as proof of a collateral agreement.
采纳该证据，作为附属协议的证明。

B. Admit the evidence as proof of the foreseeability of consequential damages.
采纳该证据，作为间接损害可预见性的证明。

C. Exclude the evidence as a prior oral agreement even if it is consistent with the terms of the parties' written agreement.
排除该证据，因其是先前的口头协议，即使它与双方书面协议的条款一致。

D. Exclude the evidence on the basis that the parties' written agreement was a fully integrated contract.
排除该证据，理由是双方的书面协议是一份完全整合的合同。
data.explanation:
Integration Types


Integration TypeDefinitionEffect
Complete integrationWriting that sets forth parties' final agreement about all termsExcludes parol evidence within scope of agreement Parol evidence inadmissible to supplement (ie, add to) or contradict contract
Partial integrationWriting that sets forth parties' final agreement about some termsExcludes parol evidence inconsistent with agreement Parol evidence admissible to supplement (not contradict) contract
The parol evidence rule bars evidence of prior or contemporaneous communications between contracting parties that supplement or contradict a written contract that is completely or fully integrated. However, this rule does not apply, and such evidence is always admissible, when the evidence is used to determine remedies for breach. For example, parol evidence is admissible to prove that consequential damages were foreseeable and are therefore recoverable.

Here, the two companies signed a fully integrated contract for the delivery of 10 gearboxes. Before doing so, the power company had told the shipping company that it would be unable to meet its contractual obligation to the town if the gearboxes were not delivered on time. Evidence of this conversation shows it was foreseeable that late delivery would cause the power company to suffer consequential damages arising from its contract with the town. Therefore, the court will likely admit the evidence as poof of the foreseeability of consequential damages.

(Choice A) The parol evidence rule does not bar evidence of a collateral agreement - ie, a separate deal with its own consideration. But here, the conversation about the delivery deadline pertained directly to the companies' written contract - not a separate deal.

(Choices C & D) Prior oral (or written) agreements are inadmissible to supplement or contradict the terms of a fully integrated contract, even if they are consistent with the terms of the contract as written. But here, the conversation regarding delivery is admissible for a different purpose - to prove the foreseeability of consequential damages.

Educational objective: The parol evidence rule bars evidence of prior or contemporaneous communications that supplement or contradict the terms of a fully integrated, written contract. But such evidence is admissible to determine remedies for breach (eg, to prove the foreseeability of consequential damages).

整合类型


整合类型定义效力
完全整合规定了双方关于所有条款最终协议的书面文件排除协议范围内的口头证据。口头证据不可采纳用以补充（即增加）或反驳合同
部分整合规定了双方关于某些条款最终协议的书面文件排除与协议不一致的口头证据。口头证据可采纳用以补充（非反驳）合同
口头证据规则禁止采纳立约双方在签订一份完全或充分整合的书面合同之前或同时进行的，且补充或反驳该书面合同的沟通证据。然而，当证据被用于确定违约的救济措施时，此规则不适用，且此类证据总是可被采纳的。例如，口头证据可被采纳以证明间接损害是可预见的，因此是可获赔偿的。

在本案中，两家公司就10个齿轮箱的交付签订了一份完全整合的合同。在此之前，电力公司已告知运输公司，如果齿轮箱未能按时交付，它将无法履行对该城镇的合同义务。该谈话的证据表明，延迟交付将导致电力公司因其与城镇的合同而遭受间接损害是可预见的。因此，法院很可能会采纳该证据，作为间接损害可预见性的证明。

(选项A) 口头证据规则不禁止关于附属协议的证据——即，一个有其自身对价的独立交易。但在本案中，关于交付截止日期的谈话直接关系到两家公司的书面合同——而非一个独立的交易。

(选项C和D) 先前的口头（或书面）协议不可被采纳以补充或反驳完全整合合同的条款，即使它们与书面合同的条款一致。但在本案中，关于交付的谈话因另一个目的而可被采纳——即证明间接损害的可预见性。

教学目的：口头证据规则禁止采纳补充或反驳一份完全整合的书面合同条款的、先前或同时进行的沟通证据。但此类证据可被采纳以确定违约的救济措施（例如，证明间接损害的可预见性）。

References

Barnett v. Hughey, 15 S.W. 464, 465 (Ark. 1891) (holding that parol evidence is admissible to determine damages in a contract dispute).

MBE 考点解析：口头证据规则与损害赔偿

正确答案：B 采纳该证据，作为间接损害可预见性的证明 (Admit the evidence as proof of the foreseeability of consequential damages)。
核心法律规则 (Legal Rules)
1. 口头证据规则 (Parol Evidence Rule, PER)

通常情况下，如果双方签署了一份完全整合 (fully integrated) 的书面合同，PER 禁止引入任何先前或同时期的口头/书面证据来补充或反驳合同条款。

2. 规则的例外：证明救济措施 (Exception: Proof of Remedy)
PER 不适用于那些不是为了改变合同条款，而是为了确定违约后果（如损害赔偿金额）的证据。
3. 间接损害 (Consequential Damages)

根据著名的 Hadley v. Baxendale 规则，只有当违约方在订立合同时能够合理预见 (reasonably foreseeable) 到这种损害，受害方才能获得间接损害赔偿。

逻辑推演 (Analysis)
1
识别目的： 运输公司试图排除的证据是“关于及时交付后果的谈话”。电力公司引入该证据不是为了改变“6月1日交货”这个条款，也不是为了增加新的义务。
2

3
得出结论： 既然证据是用来证明间接损害的可预见性（即确定赔偿范围），而非改变合同条款，因此不受口头证据规则（PER）的限制。法院会采纳该证据。

附属协议 (Collateral Agreement) 通常指一个独立的、有单独对价的附带交易。本案中的谈话直接关系到主合同的履行后果，并非独立交易。

这两个选项机械地应用了 PER。虽然合同是完全整合的，但这只意味着不能引入证据来修改条款。它并不阻止引入证据来证明损害赔偿的可预见性、欺诈、错误或先决条件。

Integration


TypeDefinitionEffect
Complete integrationWriting that sets forth parties' final agreement about all terms
  • Excludes parol evidence within scope of agreement
  • Parol evidence inadmissible to supplement (ie, add to) or contradict contract
Partial integrationWriting that sets forth parties' final agreement about some terms
  • Excludes parol evidence inconsistent with agreement
  • Parol evidence admissible to supplement (not contradict) contract
Under the UCC parol evidence rule, evidence of any prior agreement (or contemporaneous oral agreement) cannot be used to contradict the terms of an integrated writing. A writing is integrated if the parties intended for it to be a final expression of their agreement about some or all of the terms.

Here, the parties intended for the written contract to be the final expression of their agreement since they entered into the contract only after they had settled "all matters" regarding the purchase of the air-conditioning system. As a result, the court is unlikely to admit evidence of the $100,000 oral price term because it contradicts the $110,000 price term expressed in the written contract.

(Choice A) Evidence used to establish a defense to formation or enforceability of a contract (eg, mistake) is excepted from the parol evidence rule. Here, there is no evidence of mistake (eg, that the $110,000 price term in the written contract was due to a clerical error). But if there were, evidence of the mistake would be admissible.

(Choice C) Evidence used to establish a ground for granting a remedy (eg, reformation) is also excepted from the parol evidence rule. Mistake and misrepresentation are grounds for granting reformation, but the oral price term is evidence of neither.

(Choice D) A merger clause is strong but not definitive evidence that a contract is completely integrated. But here, it does not matter whether the contract was completely or partially integrated; in either case, the parties cannot use parol evidence to contradict the written terms.

Educational objective:

整合


类型定义效力
完全整合规定了双方就所有条款达成的最终协议的书面文件
  • 排除协议范围内的口头证据
  • 口头证据不可采纳，用以补充（即增加）或反驳合同
部分整合规定了双方就某些条款达成的最终协议的书面文件
  • 排除与协议不一致的口头证据
  • 口头证据可采纳，用以补充（但不能反驳）合同
根据《统一商法典》(UCC)的口头证据规则，任何先前的协议（或同期的口头协议）的证据都不能用来反驳一份整合书面文件的条款。如果双方意图将一份书面文件作为他们就部分或全部条款达成的协议的最终表述，则该文件是整合的。

在本案中，双方意图将书面合同作为他们协议的最终表述，因为他们是在解决了有关空调系统购买的“所有事宜”之后才签订合同的。因此，法院不太可能采纳关于100,000美元口头价格条款的证据，因为它与书面合同中明示的110,000美元价格条款相矛盾。

(选项A) 用于确立合同成立或可执行性的抗辩（例如，错误）的证据是口头证据规则的例外。在本案中，没有证据表明存在错误（例如，书面合同中110,000美元的价格条款是由于笔误造成的）。但如果存在错误，关于该错误的证据将是可采纳的。

(选项C) 用于确立给予救济（例如，修正）的理由的证据也属于口头证据规则的例外。错误和失实陈述是准予修正的理由，但口头价格条款并不能证明这两者中的任何一种。

(选项D) 合并条款是证明合同完全整合的有力证据，但并非决定性证据。但在本案中，合同是完全整合还是部分整合并不重要；无论在哪种情况下，双方都不能使用口头证据来反驳书面条款。

教学目的：

The UCC parol evidence rule bars evidence of any prior agreement (or contemporaneous oral agreement) that contradicts the terms of an integrated writing.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

References

  • U.C.C. § 2-202 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (parol evidence rule).

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 214 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (exceptions to parol evidence rule).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts / UCC Parol Evidence Rule
核心考点：口头证据规则 (Parol Evidence Rule) 根据 UCC § 2-202，如果书面合同被视为双方协议的最终表述（Integrated Writing），则任何先前的口头协议或同期的口头协议，都不得用于反驳（Contradict）书面合同中的条款。
本案法律分析

本题考察的是口头证据规则中最基础也是最严格的一条原则：禁止反驳书面条款。

1. 适用法律：
由于涉及工业空调系统的买卖，属于货物销售，适用《统一商法典》(UCC)。

2. 书面文件的性质：
题目指出双方在解决了“所有事宜”后签署了书面协议。这表明该文件是一份整合文件 (Integrated Writing)，即双方意图将其作为最终协议。

3. 规则应用：
书面条款 价格为 $110,000
口头证据 价格为 $100,000

口头证据直接与书面条款相冲突。无论该合同是“完全整合”还是“部分整合”，UCC 规则都明确禁止引入证据来反驳 (Contradict) 已经写明的条款。

因此，法院不会采纳该证据，正确答案为 B。

为什么选项 D 错误？
虽然合同中没有合并条款 (Merger Clause)，但这并不意味着合同就不是整合的。合并条款只是证明完全整合的有力证据，但缺乏该条款并不允许买方引入直接反驳书面价格的证据。
为什么选项 C 错误？
虽然合同修正 (Reformation) 是口头证据规则的一个例外，但这通常需要证明存在“共同错误”(Mutual Mistake) 或“欺诈”(Fraud)。本案中，买方仅仅是引用早期的谈判价格，并没有提供证据表明 $110,000 的写入是一个笔误或欺诈结果。
💡 MBE 考试技巧：
在处理 Parol Evidence Rule 问题时，首先看证据是用来做什么的：
  • 如果是用来解释 (Explain) 歧义：通常允许。
  • 如果是用来补充 (Supplement) 缺失条款：仅在部分整合时允许。
  • 如果是用来反驳 (Contradict) 现有条款：永远禁止（除非属于例外情况如欺诈、错误等）。

Admissibility of consistent additional terms

(not barred by parol evidence rule)
Common lawTerm would naturally be omitted from contract under the circumstances
UCCTerm not so important that, if agreed upon, it certainly would have been included in contract UCC = Uniform Commercial Code
The UCC parol evidence rule † generally bars evidence of a prior or contemporaneous agreement that contradicts the final written contract. But evidence of a consistent additional term is admissible unless a court determines the term is so important that it would have certainly been included in the contract. Because that standard is difficult to establish, such evidence is usually admissible.

Here, the written contract signed by the parties allowed the fancier to purchase and select a gray horse. As a result, evidence of the oral agreement to allow the fancier to purchase and select a brown horse contradicted the contract and is not admissible (Choices A & C). But because the term to include a $100 saddle would not have certainly been included in the contract, evidence of that part of the oral agreement is admissible (Choice D).

†Contracts for the sale of goods (eg, horses) are governed by Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC).

Educational objective: Under the UCC parol evidence rule, evidence of consistent additional terms is admissible unless the court determines the term is so important that, if agreed upon, it would have certainly been included in the contract.

正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

一致附加条款的可采纳性

(不为口头证据规则所禁止)
普通法在此情况下，条款会自然地从合同中被省略
UCC条款的重要性未达到如果双方同意，就肯定会包含在合同中的程度 UCC = 《美国统一商法典》
UCC口头证据规则†通常禁止引入与最终书面合同相矛盾的先前或同期的协议证据。但一致的附加条款的证据是可采纳的，除非法院认定该条款如此重要，以至于它肯定会被包含在合同中。由于该标准难以确立，此类证据通常是可采纳的。

在本案中，双方签署的书面合同允许马匹爱好者购买并选择一匹灰色马。因此，允许马匹爱好者购买并选择一匹棕色马的口头协议证据与合同相矛盾，故不可采纳（选项A和C）。但是，由于包含一个价值100美元马鞍的条款并不会必然地被包含在合同中，因此该部分口头协议的证据是可采纳的（选项D）。

†货物（例如马匹）销售合同受《美国统一商法典》（UCC）第二条管辖。

教学目标：根据UCC口头证据规则，一致附加条款的证据是可采纳的，除非法院认定该条款的重要性达到了如果双方同意，就肯定会包含在合同中的程度。

References

U.C.C. § 2-202 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (when parol evidence of consistent additional term is admissible).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Parol Evidence Rule under UCC
核心法律规则：UCC 口头证据规则

本题涉及货物买卖（马匹），因此适用《美国统一商法典》（UCC）第2条。

规则要点 (UCC § 2-202)：
当双方签署了最终的书面协议后，关于先前口头协议的证据：
  • 如果与书面条款相矛盾 (Contradict)：不可采纳 (Inadmissible)。
  • 如果是一致的附加条款 (Consistent Additional Terms)：通常可采纳 (Admissible)。

例外：如果法院认定该附加条款非常重要，以至于如果双方真的同意了，就肯定会 (Certainly) 写进合同里，那么该证据才会被排除。

本案具体分析

我们需要分别分析马匹爱好者（Buyer）想要引入的两项证据：

证据 1：不可采纳
选择棕色马的权利

Option to choose a brown horse
书面合同明确规定是“灰色马” (Gray horse)。
口头证据声称可以选择“棕色马”，这直接否定并矛盾于书面条款。
结论：根据 UCC 规则，矛盾条款的外部证据被禁止。
证据 2：可采纳
价值 $100 的马鞍

The saddle worth $100
书面合同未提及配件。增加一个马鞍并不改变马匹的价格或颜色，因此它不矛盾，属于一致的附加条款。
测试：在一个 $5,000 的交易中，遗漏一个 $100 的赠品是完全可能的，并非“肯定会”写进去。
结论：法院允许引入该证据来补充合同内容。
MBE 考试技巧

在处理 Parol Evidence Rule (PER) 问题时，请遵循以下步骤：

  1. 确定法律适用：是 Common Law（服务/房产）还是 UCC（货物）？UCC 对引入外部证据更宽容。
  2. 检查矛盾性：口头证据是否直接反驳了书面文字？如果是，直接排除（Inadmissible）。
  3. 检查一致性：如果是补充条款，问自己：“这个条款是否重要到双方肯定会把它写进合同里？”
    • 如果答案是“不一定”，则证据可采纳。
注意：本题正确答案是 B (The saddle, but not the option to choose a brown horse)。因为马鞍是补充，而棕色马是矛盾。

该男子，因为作为起草方，合同的解释将对大学不利。

C. The university, because the contract does not prohibit the university from increasing ticket prices.
该大学，因为合同并未禁止大学提高票价。

D. The university, because the man was not deprived of the opportunity to purchase tickets.
该大学，因为该男子并未被剥夺购买门票的机会。

Rules of contract interpretation


Plain-meaning rule
(most courts)
  • Court interprets contract terms according to their plain meaning (unless parties clearly intended specialized meaning)
  • Goal is to effectuate parties' outward expressions of intent
  • Extrinsic evidence may be used to clarify ambiguous or overly vague terms
Context rule
(some courts)
  • Court interprets contract terms by considering all facts & circumstances related to transaction
  • Goal is to effectuate parties' actual intent
This action for declaratory judgment asks the court to define the contracting parties' rights and obligations under their agreement. The court's main concern is to give effect to the parties' outward expressions of intent, so the court will interpret the contract according to its plain (ie, ordinary) meaning whenever possible. Accordingly, if the contract's language is clear and unambiguous, the court will stop its interpretive process with that language.†

Here, the contract's language is clear and unambiguous. So long as the man fulfills his contractual obligations (and he has), the university must provide him the "opportunity to purchase" season tickets. The contract does not contemplate any additional fees that the man must pay to retain this opportunity. Therefore, the man should prevail in his action for declaratory judgment based on the contract's plain meaning.

†The court may go outside the four corners of the document to clarify the meaning of terms that are ambiguous (ie, subject to more than one reasonable interpretation) or overly vague (ie, imprecise).

(Choice B) Under the doctrine of contra proferentem , ambiguous contract terms are interpreted against the drafter to protect the rights of the nondrafter. But this doctrine does not apply when, as here, the terms are unambiguous.

(Choice C) The contract made no guarantees regarding ticket prices, so the university is free to increase ticket prices. However, the university cannot impose additional fees that the man must pay to retain the opportunity to purchase tickets at the prevailing price, whatever that may be.

(Choice D) Although the man has not been deprived of the opportunity to purchase tickets, he would be deprived of the benefit he bargained for if he is required to pay additional fees before being allowed to exercise this opportunity.

Educational objective: The plain-meaning rule of contract interpretation instructs courts to rely on the ordinary meaning of the words if the contract's language is clear and unambiguous.

选项正确率统计：A选项 39%（正确选项），B选项 21%，C选项 6%，D选项 32%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

合同解释规则


字面含义规则
(多数法院)
  • 法院根据合同条款的字面含义进行解释（除非当事人明确意图使用特殊含义）
  • 其目标是实现当事人意图的外部表达
  • 外部证据可用于澄清有歧义或过于含糊的条款
语境规则
(部分法院)
  • 法院通过考虑与交易相关的所有事实和情况来解释合同条款
  • 其目标是实现当事人的真实意图
这项请求宣告性判决的诉讼，要求法院根据协议界定立约方的权利和义务。法院主要关注的是实现当事人意图的外部表达，因此，只要可能，法院将根据合同的字面（即普通）含义来解释合同。因此，如果合同语言清晰明确，法院的解释过程将止于该语言本身。†

在本案中，合同的语言是清晰明确的。只要该男子履行其合同义务（他已经履行了），大学就必须向他提供“购买”季票的“机会”。合同并未预见到该男子必须支付任何额外费用来保留此机会。因此，基于合同的字面含义，该男子应在其宣告性判决的诉讼中胜诉。

†法院可能会超出文件本身的四角范围，以澄清含义有歧义（即，可能存在不止一种合理解释）或过于含糊（即，不精确）的条款。

(选项B) 根据contra proferentem原则，有歧义的合同条款应作出对起草方不利的解释，以保护非起草方的权利。但当条款明确无误时，如此处所示，该原则不适用。

(选项C) 合同并未对票价作出任何保证，因此大学可以自由提高票价。然而，大学不能强加额外费用，要求该男子支付这些费用以保留以通行价格（无论价格是多少）购买门票的机会。

(选项D) 虽然该男子并未被剥夺购买门票的机会，但如果他被要求在行使此机会前支付额外费用，他将被剥夺他通过协商获得的利益。

教学目标： 合同解释的字面含义规则指示法院，在合同语言清晰明确的情况下，应依赖词语的普通含义。

References

17A Am. Jur. 2d Contracts § 325 (2020) (interpreting unambiguous contracts).

MBE 考点解析

Contract Content & Meaning

核心考点：字面含义规则 (Plain Meaning Rule)

在合同解释中，如果合同条款的语言是清晰且无歧义的 (Clear and Unambiguous)，法院将严格按照词语的普通含义 (Ordinary Meaning) 来解释，而不会引入外部证据或推测未写明的条款。

案情逻辑分析

本案的核心在于对价交换 (Exchange of Consideration) 的界定：

  • 男子的义务：购买10万美元人寿保险并指定大学为受益人。
  • 大学的义务：提供“购买季票的终身机会 (Lifelong opportunity to purchase season tickets)”。

争议点：大学后来增加的 $325 “座位许可费 (Seat License Fee)” 是否违反合同？

结论：违反。合同明确规定了获得购票机会的条件是“购买保险”。大学单方面增加额外的付费条件（许可费）才能行使该权利，这改变了合同原本清晰的条款。

选项深度解析
选项 A (正确)

理由：合同是无歧义的 (Unambiguous)。

法院首先看合同文本。文本只要求男子买保险，就给购票权。文本中没有提到“许可费”。根据字面含义规则，法院不会允许大学强加合同中未预见 (Not contemplated) 的额外费用。

选项 B (干扰项)

理由：虽然这提到了 Contra Proferentem（不利于起草方解释原则），但该原则仅在合同条款有歧义 (Ambiguous) 时才适用。

本案中，合同条款很清楚，不存在两种合理的解释，因此不需要动用这一辅助规则。选项A是更直接、更基础的法律依据。

选项 C (错误)

理由：混淆了“票价”与“许可费”。

大学确实可以涨票价 (Ticket Prices)，因为这是市场行为。但“座位许可费”是为了获得买票资格而支付的额外费用。男子已经通过买保险支付了“获得资格”的对价，大学不能要求二次付费。

选项 D (错误)

理由：实质性剥夺。

虽然男子理论上还能买票，但如果必须支付额外费用才能行使该权利，他就被剥夺了原本通过协商获得的利益 (Benefit of the Bargain)。

💡 MBE 答题技巧：
当遇到合同解释题时，遵循以下步骤：
  1. 首先问：合同语言是否清楚？
  2. 如果是清楚的，直接选基于“字面含义 (Plain Meaning)”的选项。
  3. 只有当题目明确暗示条款模棱两可时，才考虑选“不利于起草方”或涉及“外部证据 (Parol Evidence)”的选项。

If the company sues the bank for breach of contract, which of the following facts, if proved, will best support a recovery by the company?

一家计算机公司与一家银行签订书面合同，向银行出售并交付一台使用新型技术的大型计算机，该技术当时正在开发中，但尚未被公司完善，其价格远低于使用现有技术的同类计算机。合同的交付条款为“F.O.B. 银行，于7月31日或之前交付”。公司于8月15日向银行交付了该计算机。银行因交付延误而拒绝接收。

如果该公司以违约为由起诉银行，以下哪个事实一旦被证实，将最有力地支持该公司的索赔请求？
options:
A. A usage in the relevant trade allows computer sellers a 30-day leeway in a specified time of delivery, unless the usage is expressly negated by the contract.
相关行业惯例允许计算机销售商在指定的交付时间上有30天的宽限期，除非合同明确排除了该惯例。

B. On the assumption that the bank was getting a "super deal" for its money, the company believed the bank would not reject the computer because of the late tender of delivery.
基于银行在这笔交易中获得了“超级优惠”的假设，公司相信银行不会因为延迟交付而拒绝接收该计算机。

C. The company's delay in tender was caused by a truckers' strike.
公司的交付延迟是由卡车司机罢工造成的。

D. The delay did not materially harm the bank.
该延迟未对银行造成重大损害。

UCC parol evidence rule


DescriptionPriority of evidence
InadmissiblePrior/contemporaneous agreements that contradict written contractExpress terms always control
Admissible
Course of performanceSequence of conduct under contract involving repeated occasions for performanceCourse of performance > course of dealing & trade usage
Course of dealingSequence of conduct pertaining to previous contractsCourse of dealing > trade usage
Trade usageRegular practice or method of dealing in that particular business/industryN/A
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

Contracts for the sale of goods (eg, computers) are governed by Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC). Under the UCC parol evidence rule, evidence of trade usage can be used to explain or supplement the express terms of a final, written contract so long as the evidence is reasonably consistent with (ie, not negated by) those terms. Trade usage refers to a practice or method of dealing that is observed with such regularity in the industry that the parties to a contract would be expected to observe it.

Here, the computer company and bank's written contract was silent as to leeway for delivery. As a result, evidence of trade usage can be used to supplement the contract. There is a practice in the relevant trade that allows computer sellers a 30-day leeway in a specified time of delivery. Since this fact would show that the bank breached the contract by rejecting the computer because of a 15-day delay, it would best support a recovery by the company.

(Choice B) The computer company's belief that the bank would not reject the computer for late delivery because it was getting a "super deal" for its money is irrelevant.

(Choice C) A seller's delay in delivery (or nondelivery) is not a breach if performance has become commercially impracticable because of unforeseen circumstances not within the contemplation of the parties when the contract was made. But a truckers' strike is not an unforeseen circumstance that would trigger impracticability.

(Choice D) Under the UCC's perfect-tender rule, the goods and their delivery must conform to the contract in every respect. Therefore, the fact that the computer company's delay did not materially harm the bank would not support a recovery by the company.

Educational objective: The UCC parol evidence rule allows the use of trade-usage evidence to explain or supplement the terms of a final, written contract so long as the evidence is reasonably consistent with, not negated by, those terms.

UCC parol evidence rule


描述证据的优先顺序
不可采纳与书面合同相抵触的在先/同期协议明示条款始终优先
可采纳
履约过程合同项下涉及重复履行机会的一系列行为履约过程 > 交易过程 & 行业惯例
交易过程与先前合同有关的一系列行为交易过程 > 行业惯例
行业惯例在特定商业/行业中常规的实践或交易方法不适用
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

货物（例如计算机）的销售合同受《美国统一商法典》(Uniform Commercial Code, UCC) 第二条管辖。根据 UCC parol evidence rule，行业惯例的证据可用于解释或补充最终书面合同的明示条款，只要该证据与这些条款合理一致（即未被其否定）。行业惯例指的是在行业内被如此规律地遵守的一种实践或交易方法，以至于合同双方被期望会遵守它。

在本案中，计算机公司和银行的书面合同对交付的宽限期只字未提。因此，行业惯例的证据可以用来补充合同。相关行业中存在一种惯例，即允许计算机销售商在指定的交付时间上有30天的宽限期。由于这一事实将表明银行因15天的延迟而拒绝接收计算机构成违约，因此它将最有力地支持公司的索赔请求。

（选项 B） 计算机公司认为银行不会因为延迟交付而拒绝接收计算机，因为它在这笔交易中获得了“超级优惠”，这一想法是不相关的。

（选项 C） 如果由于缔约时双方未曾预料到的情况，导致履行在商业上已不可行 (commercially impracticable)，则卖方的交付延迟（或未交付）不构成违约。但是，卡车司机罢工并非足以引发商业上不可行的不可预见情况。

（选项 D） 根据 UCC 的 perfect-tender rule，货物及其交付必须在各方面都与合同相符。因此，计算机公司延迟交付并未对银行造成重大损害这一事实，并不能支持公司的索赔请求。

教学目标：UCC parol evidence rule 允许使用行业惯例证据来解释或补充最终书面合同的条款，只要该证据与这些条款合理一致，而未被其否定。

References

U.C.C. § 2-202 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (trade usage is admissible to explain or supplement contract's terms).

U.C.C. § 1-303 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (definition of trade usage).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts / UCC Article 2

UCC Parol Evidence Rule Perfect Tender Rule
核心考点：如何解释合同条款？

本题考察的是《统一商法典》(UCC) 下，如何利用外部证据来解释或补充书面合同条款。虽然合同规定了具体的交付日期，但 UCC 允许引入行业惯例 (Usage of Trade) 来证明该日期并非绝对的截止日。

UCC § 2-202 (Parol Evidence Rule):
即使是最终的书面合同，也可以通过以下证据进行解释或补充：

  • 履约过程 (Course of Performance)
  • 交易过程 (Course of Dealing)
  • 行业惯例 (Usage of Trade)

前提是这些证据与书面条款合理一致 (Reasonably Consistent)，且未被合同明确排除。

解题逻辑链条
1
适用法律： 本案涉及计算机（货物）买卖，因此适用 UCC Article 2，而非普通法 (Common Law)。
2
初步判断： 根据 UCC 的 Perfect Tender Rule (完美履约规则)，卖方必须严格按照合同规定的时间（7月31日）交付。迟延交付通常允许买方拒绝收货。
3
引入例外 (选项A)： 如果行业惯例允许 30 天的宽限期 (Leeway)，且合同没有明确写明“严禁宽限期”或“Time is of the essence”，那么这个惯例就成为了合同解释的一部分。
4
结论： 结合行业惯例，“7月31日”在法律上被解释为“7月31日及随后的30天内”。因此，8月15日的交付是符合合同约定 (Conforming) 的。既然履约符合合同，银行拒绝收货就是违约，公司可以胜诉。
⚠️ 常见陷阱 (选项 D)：
很多考生会选“延迟未造成重大损害”。

这是普通法 (Common Law) 的思维，即“实质性履行 (Substantial Performance)”原则。但在 UCC 下，对于单次交付的货物合同，适用的是 Perfect Tender Rule。只要货物或交付在任何方面不符（哪怕只有一点点延迟），买方原则上都有权拒收，无论是否造成了损害。
UCC 解释条款的优先级

当书面条款与外部证据看似冲突时，UCC 规定的优先顺序如下：

  • 1. 明示条款 (Express Terms) 最高
  • 2. 履约过程 (Course of Performance) 高
  • 3. 交易过程 (Course of Dealing) 中
  • 4. 行业惯例 (Usage of Trade) 低

*注：虽然行业惯例优先级最低，但只要它不与明示条款发生“完全不可调和的冲突”，它就是有效的补充解释。

The owner of a new office building contracted with a well-known landscaper to design and install landscaping around the building for $30,000. The agreement was memorialized in writing, was signed by both parties, and called for a budget of $5,000 for trees, shrubs, sod, and materials. The contract required the landscaper to complete the work within six months. Due to an unexpected increase in the price of trees and shrubs, the landscaper abandoned the project and never completed any of the work.
Three years after the landscaper's deadline, the building owner sued the landscaper for breach of contract. In the jurisdiction, the statute of limitations for breach of a services contract is two years after the breach, and the statute of limitations for breach of a sale-of-goods contract is four years.
Can the owner recover damages from the landscaper?

choices.a: No, because the contract is divisible with respect to the services and goods, and the landscaper's breach is therefore subject to the two-year statute of limitations.
choices.b: No, because the contract primarily calls for services, and the landscaper's breach is therefore subject to the two-year statute of limitations.
choices.c: Yes, because the landscaper's breach was a result of an increase in the price of goods, and his breach is therefore subject to the four-year statute of limitations.
choices.d: Yes, because the landscaper's breach was willful, and he is therefore estopped from denying that his breach is subject to the four-year statute of limitations.

在景观设计师应履行的最后期限过去三年后，该建筑业主以违约为由起诉了景观设计师。在该司法管辖区，服务合同违约的诉讼时效为违约行为发生后的两年，而货物销售合同违约的诉讼时效为四年。

业主能否向该景观设计师追讨损害赔偿？

Contracts for the sale of goods are governed by Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code ( UCC ), while contracts for services are governed by common law. However, some contracts involve the sale of goods and the rendering of services. To determine which law applies to a "mixed" or "hybrid" contract, courts ask whether its predominant purpose was the sale of goods or the rendering of services. The following factors are relevant to this determination:

  • The contract's language
  • The nature of the supplier's business (ie, whether it typically provides goods or services)
  • The relative value of the goods and services
  • The nature of the final product (ie, whether it can be described as a good or service)


Here, the building owner contracted to buy goods (eg, trees, shrubs, sod) and services (ie, designing and installing the landscaping). The owner likely hired the well-known landscaper due to his skill in performing landscaping services, and the $5,000 budget for goods was just one-sixth of the $30,000 contract price. Therefore, the contract primarily calls for services and is subject to the jurisdiction's two-year statute of limitations. And since the owner sued three years after the breach, the owner cannot recover damages from the landscaper.

(Choice A) While the contract is likely indivisible since it combined the sale of the trees, shrubs, and sod with their installation, this does not mean the shorter statute of limitations automatically applies. For indivisible mixed contracts, courts use the predominant-purpose test to determine which single body of law governs the entire contract. The statute of limitations corresponding to that governing law is then applied. This choice posits an incorrect legal rule.

(Choices C & D) The predominant-purpose test focuses on the parties' reason for entering the contract - not for breaching it. Therefore, it is irrelevant that the landscaper's breach was (1) a result of an increase in the price of goods or (2) willful.

Educational objective: Sale-of-goods contracts are governed by the UCC, while services contracts are governed by common law. When a contract calls for the sale of goods AND the rendering of services, the contract's primary purpose determines whether the UCC or common law applies.

货物销售合同受《Uniform Commercial Code》(UCC) 第2条管辖，而服务合同则受common law管辖。然而，有些合同既涉及货物销售，也涉及服务提供。为了确定哪种法律适用于“混合”合同，法院会审查其主要目的是货物销售还是服务提供。以下因素与此判定相关：

  • 合同的语言
  • 供应商的业务性质（即，其通常是提供货物还是服务）
  • 货物和服务的相对价值
  • 最终产品的性质（即，其可被描述为货物还是服务）


在本案中，建筑业主签订合同购买货物（如树木、灌木、草皮）和服务（即设计和安装景观）。业主很可能是因为该知名景观设计师在提供景观服务方面的技能而雇用他，并且5,000美元的货物预算仅占30,000美元合同总价的六分之一。因此，该合同的主要目的在于提供服务，并受该司法管辖区两年诉讼时效的约束。并且，由于业主在违约三年后才提起诉讼，因此业主无法向该景观设计师追讨损害赔偿。

(选项A) 虽然该合同很可能是不可分割的，因为它将树木、灌木和草皮的销售与其安装结合在一起，但这并不意味着应直接适用两者中较短的诉讼时效。对于不可分割的混合合同，法院采用的是“主要目的测试”，以确定整个合同应由哪一套法律（UCC或普通法）管辖，然后适用该法律体系下的诉讼时效。本选项提出了一个不正确的法律规则。

(选项C和D) 主要目的测试关注的是双方签订合同的原因，而非违约的原因。因此，景观设计师的违约是(1)由于货物价格上涨所致，还是(2)故意的，均不相关。

教学目标：货物销售合同受UCC管辖，而服务合同受common law管辖。当一份合同同时要求销售货物和提供服务时，应由合同的主要目的来决定是适用UCC还是common law。

References

Bonebrake v. Cox, 499 F.2d 951, 960 (8th Cir. 1974) (applying the predominant-purpose test to determine which statute of limitations applies to a mixed contract for goods and services).

Princess Cruises, Inc. v. Gen. Elec. Co., 143 F.3d 828, 833 (4th Cir. 1998) (listing factors that courts consider when applying the predominant-purpose test).

Contracts / 混合合同
⚖️ 核心考点：主要目的测试

当一份合同既涉及货物销售 (Sale of Goods) 又涉及服务 (Services) 时，法院使用 Predominant Purpose Test（主要目的测试）来决定适用哪种法律体系：

  • 主要目的是货物 ➔ 适用 UCC Article 2
  • 主要目的是服务 ➔ 适用 Common Law
🔍 案情关键事实分析
1. 合同构成：
总价 $30,000。其中 $5,000 为材料（树木、草皮等货物），剩余 $25,000 实质上是设计和安装费用（服务）。
2. 业务性质：
业主雇佣的是一位“知名景观设计师”(well-known landscaper)，重点在于其设计和安装的技能，而非单纯购买植物。
3. 法律适用判定：
由于服务价值 ($25k) 远超货物价值 ($5k)，且合同核心在于专业技能，因此该合同主要目的是服务。
🛑 诉讼时效 (Statute of Limitations)

既然确定适用 Common Law（普通法）：

  • 题目规定：服务合同违约时效为 2年。
  • 事实：业主在违约 3年后 才起诉。
  • 结论：诉讼时效已过，业主无法获得赔偿。
✅ 正确答案：选项 B

"No, because the contract primarily calls for services..."

这是对主要目的测试的正确应用。因为合同主要是关于服务的，所以适用较短的2年诉讼时效，导致诉讼被驳回。

❌ 为什么其他选项错误？

选项 A (不可分割性)：
虽然合同是混合的（不可分割），但这并不意味着这就自动适用“较短”的时效。法律要求必须先定性（UCC 或 Common Law），再适用对应的时效，而不是随意挑选。

选项 C (违约原因)：
违约是因为货物涨价（Goods price increase）这一事实，不能改变合同本身的性质。判定法律适用看的是缔约时的目的，而非违约的原因。

选项 D (故意违约)：
违约是否故意 (Willful) 通常不影响诉讼时效的长短，也不会导致被告被“禁止反言” (Estopped) 主张时效抗辩。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

遇到“混合合同”题目，先看钱（货物占比多少？），再看人（是买现成产品还是买专业技能？）。

如果是像 Bonebrake v. Cox 案确立的原则：如果服务仅仅是附带的（incidental），则适用 UCC；如果货物仅仅是附带的，则适用 Common Law。

Integration


TypeDefinitionEffect
Complete integrationWriting that sets forth parties' final agreement about all terms
  • Excludes parol evidence within scope of agreement
  • Parol evidence inadmissible to supplement (ie, add to) or contradict contract
Partial integrationWriting that sets forth parties' final agreement about some terms
  • Excludes parol evidence inconsistent with agreement
  • Parol evidence admissible to supplement (not contradict) contract
The parol evidence rule generally bars evidence of prior or contemporaneous agreements to modify or contradict the unambiguous terms of an integrated writing. But if the writing is partially integrated—ie, sets forth the parties' final agreement about some, but not all, terms—the parties can introduce supplemental evidence (oral or written) that is consistent with the writing and does not contradict its terms.

Here, just before the parties signed the written contract, they orally agreed that the remodeling of the garage was to be completed within 60 days. The contract was partially integrated because it did not specify a time to complete the remodeling and did not contain a merger clause. As a result, evidence of the parties' oral agreement is likely admissible because the time limit is an additional term that does not contradict the written contract (Choice D).

(Choices A & C) Evidence used to clarify the meaning of an ambiguous contract term is excepted from the parol evidence rule. But here, the terms of the written contract are not ambiguous. Instead, the parties' oral agreement is admissible because it is being used to supplement (and does not contradict) the terms of the written contract.

(Choice B) The oral agreement was part of the final agreement between the parties, not merely part of their negotiations, because it was made just before the written contract was signed to address a missing term.

Educational objective: The parol evidence rule does not bar evidence of prior or contemporaneous agreements to supplement (ie, add to) the terms of a partially integrated writing, provided that the evidence is consistent with and does not contradict the written terms.

整合


类型定义效力
完全整合规定了双方就所有条款达成的最终协议的书面文件
  • 排除协议范围内的口头证据
  • 口头证据不得用于补充（即增加）或反驳合同
部分整合规定了双方就部分条款达成的最终协议的书面文件
  • 排除与协议不一致的口头证据
  • 口头证据可用于补充（而非反驳）合同
口头证据规则通常禁止采纳先前或同期的协议证据，以修改或反驳一份已整合书面文件的明确条款。但是，如果该书面文件是部分整合的——即规定了双方就部分而非全部条款达成的最终协议——那么当事人可以引入与书面文件相符且不与其中条款相矛盾的补充证据（口头或书面）。

在本案中，就在双方签署书面合同之前，他们口头约定车库改造应在60天内完成。该合同是部分整合的，因为它没有明确规定完成改造的时间，也没有包含合并条款。因此，关于双方口头协议的证据很可能被采纳，因为时间限制是一个附加条款，并不与书面合同相矛盾（选项D）。

(选项A和C) 用于澄清合同模糊条款含义的证据是口头证据规则的例外。但在本案中，书面合同的条款并不模糊。相反，双方的口头协议之所以可以采纳，是因为它被用来补充（且不反驳）书面合同的条款。

(选项B) 该口头协议是双方最终协议的一部分，而不仅仅是他们谈判的一部分，因为它是在签署书面合同之前为了解决一个缺失条款而达成的。

教学目标： 口头证据规则不禁止采纳先前或同期的协议证据来补充（即增加）一份部分整合书面文件的条款，前提是该证据与书面条款相符且不相矛盾。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 216 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (parol evidence is admissible to explain or supplement a term when agreement is partially integrated).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Parol Evidence Rule

核心法律规则：口头证据规则 The Parol Evidence Rule (PER)

该规则旨在确定书面合同之外的先前或同期协议（口头或书面）是否可以作为证据进入法庭。关键在于判断书面合同的整合程度 (Level of Integration)。

案情关键点分析

  • 书面合同：只有一页纸，未规定完工时间。
  • 口头协议：签署前约定“60天完工”。
  • 关键缺失：合同中没有合并条款 (Merger Clause)。

合并条款通常表述为：“本合同包含双方的完整协议” ("This contract contains the entire agreement between the parties")。

正确答案：D

法院会采纳该证据，因为时间限制是附加条款，且不与部分整合的书面合同相矛盾。

推理逻辑：

  1. 部分整合 (Partial Integration)： 由于合同很短、缺少关键条款（时间），且没有合并条款，法院通常会认定这是一份“部分整合”的协议。这意味着书面文件是最终的，但并不完整。
  2. 补充证据 (Supplementation)： 对于部分整合的合同，允许引入一致的附加条款 (Consistent Additional Terms) 来补充合同内容。
  3. 不矛盾 (No Contradiction)： 书面合同对时间“保持沉默”，因此口头约定的“60天”并不反驳书面内容，而是对其进行补充。

为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A 错误：
虽然法院通常依据书面条款解释合同（四角规则 Four Corners Rule），但在部分整合的情况下，PER 允许引入外部证据来补充缺失的条款。
选项 B 错误：
这不仅仅是“谈判” (Negotiations)。双方明确达成了口头协议。PER 的目的正是为了筛选哪些谈判内容成为了具有约束力的协议的一部分。
选项 C 错误：
虽然“模糊” (Ambiguity) 是引入外部证据的一个例外，但这里的情况更准确地描述为条款缺失而非语义模糊。本题的考点在于“补充部分整合的合同”，而非“解释模糊条款”。
MBE 考试通关秘籍

遇到涉及书面合同 + 签署前的口头对话的题目时：

  1. 首先检查是否有合并条款 (Merger Clause)。如果有，通常推定为完全整合，排除补充证据。
  2. 如果没有合并条款，且合同看起来简略，通常判定为部分整合。
  3. 如果是部分整合，问自己：口头内容是反驳了书面内容（不可采纳），还是补充了书面内容（可采纳）？

在协议签署前不久，房主和规划师口头约定，除非房主的配偶批准该景观设计，否则该书面文件对任何一方均不具约束力。

如果房主的配偶不批准该设计，且房主拒绝允许规划师进行该工作，那么在规划师对房主提起的违约诉讼中，关于该口头协议的证据是否可以被采纳？
options:
A. No, because the parol evidence rule bars evidence of a prior oral agreement even if the latter is consistent with the terms of a partial integration.

B. No, because the prior oral agreement contradicted the writing by making the parties' duties conditional.
不可以，因为先前的口头协议通过使双方的义务附带条件，从而与书面文件相矛盾。

C. Yes, because the evidence shows that the writing was intended to take effect only if the approval occurred.

data.explanation:
Exceptions to parol evidence rule

Evidence of prior or contemporaneous oral or written agreement is admissible to establish:

  • whether writing is integrated and, if so, completely or partially
  • meaning of ambiguous term
  • defense to formation or enforcement (eg, fraud, duress, mistake)
  • ground for granting or denying remedy (eg, rescission, reformation)
  • subsequent contract modifications
  • condition precedent to effectiveness

The parol evidence rule generally bars evidence of a prior or contemporaneous agreement to modify or contradict the terms of an integrated writing. But this rule does not apply when a party is attacking the validity of the agreement - eg, by asserting there was a condition precedent to effectiveness that failed to occur. As a result, evidence of such a condition precedent is admissible.

Here, before the writing was signed, the parties orally agreed that it would become binding (ie, take effect) only if the owner's spouse approved the landscape design - a condition precedent to effectiveness. Therefore, the parol evidence rule does not bar evidence of the oral agreement, and that evidence is likely admissible (Choice C).

(Choice A) The parol evidence rule allows evidence of a prior agreement if that agreement is consistent with the terms of a partial integration (ie, a writing that sets forth the parties' final agreement about some, but not all, terms).

(Choice B) is incorrect because the prior oral agreement did not contradict the writing. Instead, it established a condition precedent to the contract's effectiveness, which is a recognized exception to the parol evidence rule.

(Choice D) The oral agreement is admissible because it evidences a condition precedent to effectiveness; the fact that the oral agreement required approval by a third party is irrelevant.

Educational objective: Evidence used to establish a condition precedent that must occur before a contract becomes effective is admissible under the parol evidence rule.

正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

parol evidence rule的例外情况

在先的或同期的口头或书面协议的证据，在为了证明以下情况时可被采纳：

  • 书面文件是否为整合协议，以及如果是，是完全整合还是部分整合
  • 模糊条款的含义
  • 合同成立或执行的抗辩（例如，欺诈、胁迫、错误）
  • 批准或拒绝救济的理由（例如，撤销、修正）
  • 后续的合同修改
  • 合同生效的先决条件

parol evidence rule通常禁止采纳旨在修改或否定一份整合书面协议条款的、在先的或同期的协议证据。但是，当一方当事人攻击协议的有效性时——例如，主张一个生效的先决条件未能满足时——该规则不适用。因此，关于此类生效先决条件的证据是可采纳的。

在本案中，在书面文件签署之前，双方口头约定，只有在房主的配偶批准景观设计后，该文件才具有约束力（即生效）——这是一个合同生效的先决条件。因此，parol evidence rule不禁止采纳该口头协议的证据，该证据很可能被采纳(选项 C)。

(选项 A) parol evidence rule允许采纳在先协议的证据，如果该协议与部分整合协议（即，一份仅阐述了双方就部分而非全部条款达成的最终协议的书面文件）的条款相一致。

(选项 B)是不正确的，因为先前的口头协议并未与书面文件相矛盾。相反，它确立了合同生效的先决条件，这是parol evidence rule的一个公认的例外情况。

(选项 D)该口头协议可被采纳，因为它证明了合同生效的一个先决条件；该口头协议要求第三方批准这一事实并不相关。

教学目标：用于证明在合同生效前必须满足的先决条件的证据，根据parol evidence rule是可被采纳的。

MBE 考点解析

Contract Law: Parol Evidence Rule
核心考点：口头证据规则的例外

本题考察的是 口头证据规则 (Parol Evidence Rule, PER) 的一个重要例外：生效先决条件 (Condition Precedent to Effectiveness)。

1 一般规则 (The General Rule)

通常情况下，如果双方签署了一份旨在作为最终协议的“整合书面文件”(Integrated Writing)，PER 禁止引入任何在签署之前或同时达成的、与书面内容相矛盾的口头协议证据。

2 关键例外 (The Exception)

然而，PER 并不禁止引入证据来证明合同根本没有生效。如果双方口头约定，书面合同只有在满足特定条件后才生效，这种证据是可采纳的 (Admissible)。

这被称为 Condition Precedent to Effectiveness。这种证据不是为了修改合同条款，而是为了证明合同的法律效力从未产生。

3 本案应用 (Application)
  • 书面：房主与规划师签署了详细合同。
  • 口头：签署前约定“除非配偶批准，否则不具约束力”。
  • 结果：配偶未批准。

这里的口头协议设定了一个“开关”。因为开关（配偶批准）没有开启，书面合同虽然签署了，但在法律上从未“启动”。因此，房主可以引入该证据来证明自己没有违约义务。

正确答案：C

理由：选项 C 准确指出了该证据的作用——证明书面文件意图仅在获得批准后才生效。这符合 Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 217 的规定。

⚠️ 常见陷阱 (Distractor Analysis)

为什么 B 选项是错的？
很多考生会误选 B，认为口头条件与书面承诺（无条件付款）相矛盾。但在法律上，“生效条件”不被视为与“履行条款”相矛盾。它只是暂停了整个合同的效力，而不是改变了合同里的具体义务。

为什么 A 选项是错的？
A 选项错误地陈述了法律规则。即使是部分整合协议，PER 也不禁止一致的补充条款。更重要的是，本题属于“有效性”例外，PER 根本不适用。

🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 合同法题目中，当你看到：

  1. 一份看起来很正式的书面合同；
  2. 但在签字前，有人口头说：“除非 X 发生，否则这不算数/不生效”；

请立即想到 Condition Precedent to Effectiveness。这种口头证据永远是可采纳的 (Admissible)。

A homeowner went to an appliance store to purchase a new refrigerator. The homeowner's old refrigerator had just been destroyed by an electrical surge, and he needed to purchase a new one immediately to prevent food spoilage. The homeowner did not understand English, so he conversed with the salesperson in Spanish.
The homeowner told the salesperson about the electrical surge and explained that he did not have enough cash for a new refrigerator. The salesperson told the homeowner not to worry because the appliance store offered no-interest financing for a "small finance fee." Then the homeowner signed a contract printed in English. The contract provided for a purchase price of $900, payable in three equal monthly installments, plus a finance fee of $500. The homeowner made three installment payments of $300 each but never paid the finance fee.
If the appliance store sues the homeowner for breach of contract and seeks to exclude any evidence of the conversation between the homeowner and the salesperson, how will the court likely rule?

choices.a: Admit the evidence as proof of a collateral agreement.
choices.b: Admit the evidence as proof of unfair surprise in the contract's terms.
choices.c: Exclude the evidence as contradicting an unambiguous term of the contract.
choices.d: Exclude the evidence on the basis of a finding that the contract was completely integrated.

一名房主去家电商店购买新冰箱。该房主的旧冰箱刚因电涌而损坏，他需要立即购买一台新冰箱以防止食物腐坏。该房主不懂英文，因此他用西班牙语与销售人员交谈。

房主告诉销售人员电涌的事情，并解释说他没有足够的现金购买新冰箱。销售人员告诉房主不必担心，因为家电商店提供无息融资，只需支付一笔“小额融资费”。随后，房主签署了一份以英文打印的合同。合同规定购买价格为900美元，分三期等额月付，外加500美元的融资费。房主支付了三期每期300美元的分期付款，但从未支付融资费。

如果家电商店以违约为由起诉该房主，并试图排除房主与销售人员之间对话的任何证据，法院可能会如何裁决？
options:
A. Admit the evidence as proof of a collateral agreement.
采纳该证据，作为附属协议的证明。

B. Admit the evidence as proof of unfair surprise in the contract's terms.
采纳该证据，作为合同条款中存在不公平意外的证明。

C. Exclude the evidence as contradicting an unambiguous term of the contract.
排除该证据，因为其与合同中明确无误的条款相矛盾。

D. Exclude the evidence on the basis of a finding that the contract was completely integrated.
基于合同是完全整合的认定，排除该证据。
data.explanation:
The parol evidence rule bars evidence of prior or contemporaneous communications between contracting parties that contradict the unambiguous terms of a written contract that is completely or partially integrated. But this rule does not apply to evidence that is offered to establish a defense to the enforceability of the contract. One such defense is unconscionability, which is available if the contract involves some element of unfair surprise.

Here, the homeowner signed a written contract to purchase the refrigerator. Before doing so, the homeowner had told the salesperson about his financial situation, and the salesperson had told the homeowner that the store offered no-interest financing for a "small fee." Evidence of this conversation shows that the $500 finance fee for a $900 refrigerator was not in line with the homeowner's expectations - particularly since the contract was in English. Therefore, the court should admit the conversation as proof of unconscionability due to unfair surprise.

  • However, evidence of prior or contemporaneous communications that supplement (ie, add to) but do not contradict the writing is only barred by the parol evidence rule if the contract is completely integrated.


(Choice A) The parol evidence rule does not apply to evidence of a collateral agreement - ie, a separate deal with its own consideration. But here, the conversation between the salesperson and the homeowner did not concern a separate deal since it directly applied to the sale of the refrigerator.

(Choice C) Evidence that the finance fee was characterized as "small" would ordinarily be barred by the parol evidence rule because it contradicts the unambiguous, $500 finance fee in the contract's terms. But since the evidence helps show that the fee unfairly surprised the homeowner, it is admissible.

(Choice D) Even if a contract is completely integrated, parol evidence may be offered to establish a defense to the enforceability of the contract (eg, unconscionability).

Educational objective: The parol evidence rule does NOT bar evidence of prior or contemporaneous communications between contracting parties when the evidence is offered to establish a defense to enforceability (eg, unconscionability).

选项正确率统计：A选项 10%，B选项 64%（正确选项），C选项 15%，D选项 9%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

口头证据规则（parol evidence rule）禁止采纳立约方之间在先的或同期的、与一份完全或部分整合的书面合同中明确无误的条款相矛盾的交流证据。但此规则不适用于为确立合同可执行性的抗辩而提出的证据。不合情理（unconscionability）就是这样一种抗辩，当合同包含某些不公平意外的要素时即可适用。

在本案中，房主签署了一份购买冰箱的书面合同。在此之前，房主已告知销售人员其财务状况，销售人员也告知房主商店提供无息融资，只需支付一笔“小额费用”。这段对话的证据表明，一台900美元冰箱的500美元融资费不符合房主的预期——特别是在合同是用英文写成的情况下。因此，法院应采纳这段对话，作为因不公平意外而导致不合情理的证明。

  • 然而，对于补充（即增加）书面合同内容但不与之矛盾的在先或同期交流证据，只有在合同是完全整合的情况下，口头证据规则才会禁止采纳。


(选项 A) 口头证据规则不适用于附属协议的证据——即，一个有其自身对价（consideration）的独立交易。但在本案中，销售人员与房主之间的对话不涉及独立交易，因为它直接适用于冰箱的销售。

(选项 C) 融资费被描述为“小额”的证据通常会被口头证据规则所禁止，因为它与合同条款中明确的500美元融资费相矛盾。但由于该证据有助于证明该费用对房主构成了不公平意外，因此可以被采纳。

(选项 D) 即使合同是完全整合的，口头证据也可以被提出来确立合同可执行性的抗辩（例如，不合情理）。

教学目的：当证据是为了确立可执行性的抗辩（例如，不合情理）而提出时，口头证据规则不禁止采纳立约方之间的在先或同期交流的证据。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 214 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (exceptions to parol evidence rule).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Parol Evidence Rule

核心法律规则 (The Rule) 口头证据规则 (Parol Evidence Rule, PER) 通常禁止引入与书面合同相矛盾的外部证据。但是，该规则有一个至关重要的例外：

如果证据是为了证明合同存在可执行性抗辩 (Defense to Enforceability)，如欺诈、胁迫、错误或显失公平 (Unconscionability)，则该证据是可采纳的 (Admissible)。
案情逻辑分析

本案的关键在于区分“试图改变合同条款”与“试图证明合同无效”。

  • 书面合同：明确规定了 $500 的融资费。
  • 口头证据：销售员说是“小额费用” (Small fee)。
  • 矛盾点：$500 占 $900 商品价格的 55% 以上，显然不是“小额”。
  • 背景事实：房主不懂英语，且急需冰箱（处于弱势地位）。

如果房主试图引入证据仅仅是为了说“我们当时商量的是50美元，不是500美元”，这通常会被 PER 禁止。但在这里，房主是为了证明不公平的意外 (Unfair Surprise)，这是显失公平 (Unconscionability) 的一个要素。

选项深度解析
正确答案 B 采纳该证据，作为合同条款中存在不公平意外的证明。

这是 PER 的经典例外。法院允许引入外部证据来证明合同本身因“显失公平”而不可执行。这里的“不公平意外”源于语言障碍和销售员的误导性陈述。

错误选项 C 排除该证据，因为其与合同中明确无误的条款相矛盾。

这是最强的干扰项。通常情况下 PER 确实禁止矛盾证据。但考生必须识别出本题涉及合同的有效性/可执行性问题。当证据用于攻击合同的有效性时，PER 不适用。

错误选项 D 基于合同是完全整合的认定，排除该证据。

即使合同是“完全整合” (Completely Integrated) 的，即双方意图让书面文件包含所有条款，也不会阻止引入证据来证明欺诈、显失公平或其他导致合同无效的抗辩事由。

💡MBE 提分技巧

在处理 Parol Evidence Rule 的题目时，请按以下步骤思考：
  1. 看目的：引入证据是为了改变条款（如价格、日期），还是为了推翻整个合同？
  2. 找例外：如果是为了证明 Fraud (欺诈), Duress (胁迫), Mistake (错误), 或 Unconscionability (显失公平)，PER 永远拦不住。
  3. 关键词：看到 "Language Barrier" (语言障碍) + "Misrepresentation" (虚假陈述) + "High Fees" (高额费用)，通常指向 Unconscionability。

A seller and a buyer have dealt with each other in hundreds of separate grain contracts over the last five years. In performing each contract, the seller delivered the grain to the buyer and, upon delivery, the buyer signed an invoice that showed an agreed-upon price for that delivery. Each invoice was silent in regard to any discount from the price for prompt payment. The custom of the grain trade is to allow a 2% discount from the invoice price for payment within 10 days of delivery. In all of their prior transactions and without objection from the seller, the buyer took 15 days to pay and deducted 5% from the invoice price.
The seller and the buyer recently entered into a contract for a single delivery of wheat at a price of $300,000. The same delivery procedure and invoice were used for this contract as had been used previously. The seller delivered the wheat and the buyer then signed the invoice. On the third day after delivery, the buyer received the following note from the seller: "Payment in full in accordance with signed invoice is due immediately. No discounts permitted. s/Seller."
Which of the following statements concerning these facts is most accurate?

choices.a: The custom of the trade controls, and the buyer is entitled to take a 2% discount if he pays within 10 days.
choices.b: The parties' course of dealing controls, and the buyer is entitled to take a 5% discount if he pays within 15 days.
choices.c: The seller's retraction of his prior waiver controls, and the buyer is entitled to no discount.
choices.d: The written contract controls, and the buyer is entitled to no discount because of the parol evidence rule.

一个卖方和一个买方在过去五年中进行了数百次独立的谷物合同交易。在履行每份合同时，卖方将谷物交付给买方，在交付时，买方签署了一张发票，上面写明了该次交付的约定价格。每张发票均未提及即时付款可享受的价格折扣。谷物贸易的惯例是，在交货后10天内付款可享受发票价格2%的折扣。在他们之前的所有交易中，买方均在15天内付款，并从发票价格中扣除了5%，卖方对此并无异议。

卖方和买方最近签订了一份单一批次小麦的交付合同，价格为300,000美元。该合同采用了与以往相同的交付程序和发票。卖方交付了小麦，买方随后签署了发票。交货后第三天，买方收到了卖方的如下便条：“请立即根据已签署的发票全额付款。不允许任何折扣。s/卖方。”

关于这些事实，以下哪项陈述最为准确？
options:
A. The custom of the trade controls, and the buyer is entitled to take a 2% discount if he pays within 10 days.
交易惯例具有约束力，如果买方在10天内付款，则有权享受2%的折扣。

B. The parties' course of dealing controls, and the buyer is entitled to take a 5% discount if he pays within 15 days.
双方的交易过程具有约束力，如果买方在15天内付款，则有权享受5%的折扣。

C. The seller's retraction of his prior waiver controls, and the buyer is entitled to no discount.
卖方对其先前弃权的撤回具有约束力，买方无权享受任何折扣。

D. The written contract controls, and the buyer is entitled to no discount because of the parol evidence rule.
书面合同具有约束力，根据口头证据规则，买方无权享受任何折扣。
data.explanation:
Course of performance, course of dealing & trade usage


Course of performanceSequence of conduct that is relevant to understanding an agreement between parties if the agreement involves repeated occasions for performance by one party and the other party accepts performance without objection.
Course of dealingSequence of conduct concerning previous transactions between parties that establishes a common basis of understanding for interpreting their conduct.
Trade usagePractice or method of dealing in the parties' business or industry that is observed with enough regularity to justify an expectation that it will be observed in the instant case.
Under the UCC parol evidence rule, evidence of a prior agreement (or contemporaneous oral agreement) cannot be used to contradict the terms of a final written agreement. But evidence of the parties' course of performance, the parties' course of dealing, or trade usage can always be used to explain or supplement those terms. If the evidence is inconsistent, priority is given as follows:
  • Express terms prevail over all others
  • Course of performance prevails over course of dealing and trade usage
  • Course of dealing prevails over trade usage
Here, the contract at issue was silent regarding discounts for prompt payment. However, in all of their hundreds of prior transactions and without objection from the seller, the buyer had taken 15 days to pay and deducted 5% from the invoice price. This established a course of dealing that can be used to supplement the terms of the contract (Choice D). And although the custom of the trade is to allow a 2% discount for payment within 10 days, the parties' course of dealing controls (Choice A). Therefore, the buyer is entitled to a 5% discount if he pays within 15 days.

(Choice C) Waiver (or retraction thereof) is not an issue in this question because the contract was silent regarding discounts for prompt payment.

In other words, there was no relevant term capable of being waived.

Educational objective: Express contractual terms prevail over all others, the parties' course of performance prevails over their course of dealing and trade usage, and their course of dealing prevails over trade usage.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 73%（正确选项），C选项 10%，D选项 9%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

履约过程、交易过程与行业惯例


履约过程 (Course of performance)如果协议涉及一方重复履行，而另一方无异议地接受其履行，则与理解该协议相关的一系列行为。
交易过程 (Course of dealing)关乎双方先前交易的一系列行为，该系列行为为解释其当前行为建立了共同的理解基础。
行业惯例 (Trade usage)在当事人所属行业或业务中，被遵守的频率足以证明在本案中亦应被遵守的惯常做法或交易方法。
根据UCC口头证据规则，先前协议（或同期口头协议）的证据不能用于反驳最终书面协议的条款。但是，当事人的履约过程、交易过程或行业惯例的证据，始终可以用来解释或补充这些条款。如果这些证据不一致，其优先顺序如下：
  • 明示条款优先于所有其他证据
  • 履约过程优先于交易过程和行业惯例
  • 交易过程优先于行业惯例
在本案中，争议合同并未规定即时付款的折扣。然而，在他们之前数百次的交易中，买方都在15天内付款并扣除了发票价格的5%，且卖方未提出异议。这建立了一个可以用来补充合同条款的交易过程（选项D）。并且，尽管行业惯例是允许在10天内付款可享受2%的折扣，但双方的交易过程具有优先适用效力（选项A）。因此，如果买方在15天内付款，他有权享受5%的折扣。

（选项C）弃权（或其撤回）在本问题中不成其为争点，因为合同并未规定即时付款的折扣。

换言之，不存在可被放弃的相关条款。

教学目的：合同明示条款优先于所有其他证据，当事人的履约过程优先于其交易过程和行业惯例，而其交易过程又优先于行业惯例。

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

MBE 考点解析

UCC 合同解释与证据层级

核心考点：UCC 解释规则 根据《统一商法典》(UCC)，当书面合同对某一条款（如付款折扣）保持沉默 (Silent) 时，可以使用外部证据来解释或补充合同内容。证据的效力有严格的优先顺序。
证据优先层级 (Hierarchy)

当证据之间发生冲突时，UCC § 1-303 规定了如下优先顺序：

1. 明示条款 (Express Terms)
↓ 优于
2. 履约过程 (Course of Performance)
↓ 优于
3. 交易过程 (Course of Dealing)
↓ 优于
4. 行业惯例 (Usage of Trade)
本案事实分析
  • 合同现状：书面发票对折扣问题“保持沉默”。
  • 交易过程 (Course of Dealing)：双方过去5年数百次交易中，买方均在15天内付款并扣除5%，卖方无异议。
  • 行业惯例 (Usage of Trade)：行业通常做法是10天内付款扣除2%。
  • 冲突：交易过程（5%折扣） vs 行业惯例（2%折扣）。
✅ 正确答案：B

理由：根据 UCC 的优先规则，双方特定的交易过程 (Course of Dealing) 优先于一般的行业惯例 (Usage of Trade)。

因为双方在过去的数百次交易中已经建立了一种特定的理解（15天付款享5%折扣），这种理解构成了合同的一部分，补充了沉默的条款。卖方事后单方面发出的“全额付款”通知不能改变已经形成的合同条款。
为什么其他选项是错的？
❌ 选项 A (行业惯例)： 只有在没有“交易过程”证据时，行业惯例才适用。既然双方有特定的交易历史，历史做法优先于行业通用做法。
❌ 选项 C (撤回弃权)： 这并非“弃权 (Waiver)”问题。弃权通常指一方原谅了另一方的违约行为。在这里，基于双方的历史，5%的折扣被视为合同的隐含条款，而非卖方对违约的宽恕。因此不存在可以单方面撤回的弃权。
❌ 选项 D (口头证据规则 PER)： UCC 的口头证据规则 (Parol Evidence Rule, UCC § 2-202) 确实禁止用外部证据来反驳 (Contradict) 最终书面协议。但是，它明确允许使用交易过程、履约过程或行业惯例来解释或补充 (Explain or Supplement) 合同，特别是当合同对某事项（如折扣）保持沉默时。
💡 MBE 提分技巧
看到 UCC 合同题目中出现“书面合同沉默” + “双方历史做法” + “行业惯例”的组合时：
  1. 首先确认合同是否属于 UCC（货物买卖）。
  2. 记住口诀：具体优于一般。
  3. 现行合同行为 (Performance) > 过去历史 (Dealing) > 行业通例 (Trade)。
  4. PER 规则挡不住这些证据用来“补充”沉默条款。

questions.question:
A farmer contracted to sell 100,000 bushels of wheat to a buyer. When the wheat arrived at the destination, the buyer discovered that the farmer had delivered only 96,000 bushels. The buyer sued the farmer for breach of contract. At the trial of the case, the court found that the written contract was intended as a complete and exclusive statement of the terms of the agreement. The farmer offered to prove that in the wheat business, a promise to deliver a specified quantity is considered to be satisfied if the delivered quantity is within 5% of the specified quantity. The buyer objected to the offered evidence.
Is the court likely to admit the evidence offered by the farmer?

choices.a: No, because the offered evidence is inconsistent with the express language of the agreement.
choices.b: No, because the written contract was totally integrated.
choices.c: Yes, because the offered evidence demonstrates that the farmer substantially performed the contract.
choices.d: Yes, because the offered evidence explains or supplements the agreement by usage of trade.

一位农民与一位买方签订合同，向其出售10万蒲式耳的小麦。当小麦运抵目的地时，买方发现农民仅交付了96,000蒲式耳。买方以违约为由起诉了该农民。在案件审理过程中，法院认定该书面合同旨在作为协议条款的完整且排他性的陈述。农民提出证据以证明，在小麦行业中，如果交付数量在约定数量的5%以内，则交付特定数量的承诺被视为已履行。买方对所提出的证据表示反对。

法院是否可能采纳农民提出的证据？
options:
A. No, because the offered evidence is inconsistent with the express language of the agreement.
不会，因为所提出的证据与协议的明确表述不符。

B. No, because the written contract was totally integrated.
不会，因为该书面合同是完全一体化的。

C. Yes, because the offered evidence demonstrates that the farmer substantially performed the contract.
会，因为所提出的证据表明农民已实质性履行了合同。

D. Yes, because the offered evidence explains or supplements the agreement by usage of trade.
会，因为所提出的证据通过行业惯例解释或补充了协议。
data.explanation:
UCC parol evidence rule


DescriptionPriority of evidence
InadmissiblePrior/contemporaneous agreements that contradict written contractExpress terms always control
Admissible
Course of performance		Sequence of conduct under contract involving repeated occasions for performanceCourse of performance > course of dealing & trade usage
Course of dealingSequence of conduct pertaining to previous contractsCourse of dealing > trade usage
Trade usageRegular practice or method of dealing in that particular business/industryN/A
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

Under the UCC's parol evidence rule, the express terms of a completely integrated, written contract cannot be contradicted by evidence of inconsistent prior or contemporaneous agreements. However, evidence of trade usage can be admitted to explain or supplement contract terms so long as that evidence is reasonably consistent with the contract's express language.† Trade usage refers to a practice or method of dealing that is observed with such regularity in the industry that the parties to a contract would be expected to observe it.

Here, the farmer delivered 96,000 bushels of wheat instead of the 100,000 bushels expressly required by the completely integrated contract. However, evidence shows that in the wheat industry, a delivery is satisfied if the delivered quantity is within 5% of the quantity specified in the contract. And since this evidence of trade usage is reasonably consistent with the contract's express language, the court is likely to admit the farmer's evidence of trade usage to supplement the contract (Choices A & B).

†Under the majority rule, trade usage is consistent with express language in the contract unless the usage completely negates specific express language.

(Choice C) Under the UCC's perfect-tender rule, a seller breaches a contract for the sale of goods when those goods or their delivery do not perfectly conform to the contract's terms (as seen here). Therefore, evidence showing that the farmer substantially performed is unlikely to be admitted because it does not excuse the farmer's breach.

Educational objective: The UCC parol evidence rule allows the admission of evidence of trade usage to explain or supplement a contract's terms if that evidence is reasonably consistent with the express language of the contract.

选项正确率统计：A选项 8%，B选项 7%，C选项 4%，D选项 79%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

UCC 口头证据规则 (parol evidence rule)


描述证据的优先顺序
不可采纳与书面合同相矛盾的在先或同期协议明确条款始终具有控制力
可采纳
履约过程 (Course of performance)		合同项下涉及重复履约机会的一系列行为履约过程 > 交易过程 & 行业惯例
交易过程 (Course of dealing)与先前合同相关的一系列行为交易过程 > 行业惯例
行业惯例 (Trade usage)在该特定商业/行业中的常规做法或交易方法不适用
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code (《美国统一商法典》)

根据UCC的口头证据规则，完全一体化的书面合同的明确条款，不能被不一致的在先或同期协议的证据所反驳。但是，只要行业惯例的证据与合同的明确表述合理一致，就可以被采纳用以解释或补充合同条款。† 行业惯例指的是在行业中被如此有规律地遵守的做法或交易方法，以至于合同双方被期望会遵守它。

在本案中，农民交付了96,000蒲式耳的小麦，而不是完全一体化合同中明确要求的100,000蒲式耳。然而，有证据表明，在小麦行业中，如果交付数量在合同规定数量的5%以内，则交付被视为已完成。由于这一行业惯例的证据与合同的明确表述合理一致，法院很可能会采纳农民提出的行业惯例证据来补充合同（选项A和B）。

†根据多数派规则，行业惯例与合同中的明确表述是一致的，除非该惯例完全否定了特定的明确表述。

（选项C） 根据UCC的完全履行规则 (perfect-tender rule)，当货物或其交付未能完全符合合同条款时（如本案所示），卖方即构成对货物销售合同的违约。因此，表明农民已实质性履行的证据不太可能被采纳，因为它不能免除农民的违约责任。

教学目标： UCC的口头证据规则允许采纳行业惯例的证据来解释或补充合同条款，前提是该证据与合同的明确表述合理一致。

References

U.C.C. § 2-202 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (trade usage is admissible to explain or supplement contract's terms).

U.C.C. § 1-303 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (definition of trade usage).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: UCC Parol Evidence Rule
正确答案：D

是的，因为所提出的证据通过行业惯例 (Usage of Trade) 解释或补充了协议。

核心考点：UCC 口头证据规则

本题考察的是《统一商法典》(UCC) 第 2-202 条关于口头证据规则 (Parol Evidence Rule) 的特殊规定。

UCC § 2-202 规则要点：
即使书面合同是“完全一体化”(Totally Integrated) 的，即双方意图将其作为协议的完整且排他性陈述，法院仍然允许引入以下三类证据来解释 (Explain) 或补充 (Supplement) 合同条款：
  1. 履约过程 (Course of Performance)
  2. 交易过程 (Course of Dealing)
  3. 行业惯例 (Usage of Trade)
法律逻辑分析

1. 为什么合同的“完整性”没有阻止该证据？
在普通法 (Common Law) 下，如果合同是完全一体化的，通常严禁引入外部证据。但在 UCC（货物买卖）下，法律假定合同的词语是在特定的商业背景下使用的。因此，除非合同明确且仔细地否定了行业惯例的适用（例如明确写着“行业惯例不适用”），否则行业惯例被视为合同的隐含背景。

2. 为什么不是“不一致” (Inconsistent)？
选项 A 错误地认为 96,000 与 100,000 是矛盾的。在法律解释上，UCC 采取了非常自由的观点：
解释原则 行业惯例并不是在说“100,000 等于 96,000”，而是在解释在小麦行业中，“100,000”这个词的定义实际上包含了“正负 5% 的误差范围”。因此，这被视为“解释或补充”，而非“矛盾”。

排除干扰项
❌ 选项 A & B (不可采纳)：
错误。如上所述，UCC 允许行业惯例补充完全一体化的合同，且通常不认为其与数量条款构成法律上的“矛盾”。
❌ 选项 C (实质性履行)：
这是一个典型的陷阱！
Substantial Performance (实质性履行) 是普通法（如建筑合同）的概念。

在 UCC 货物买卖中，适用的是 Perfect Tender Rule (完全履行规则)。如果货物不完全符合合同（数量短缺），买方原则上可以拒收。

本题的关键不在于农民是否“尽力了”或“差不多完成了”，而在于通过行业惯例证明农民的交付实际上是符合合同定义的“完全履行”。
UCC 解释性证据层级
优先级 证据类型 (英文) 定义
1 (最高) Express Terms 合同的明文规定
2 Course of Performance 本次合同中之前的履行行为
3 Course of Dealing 双方过去合同的交易历史
4 Usage of Trade 行业内的普遍做法 (本题考点)
💡 MBE 考试技巧：
看到 Sale of Goods (货物买卖) + Written Contract (书面合同) + Industry Standard (行业标准) 时：
👉 几乎总是选择允许引入证据的选项。UCC 极度倾向于通过商业惯例来还原双方真实的商业意图。

questions.question:
An actor straight out of drama school and an agent entered into a one-year written contract that described the services the agent would provide. Because he was eager for work, the actor agreed, in the contract, to pay the agent 15% of his yearly earnings. At the end of the year, the actor was so pleased with his many roles that he gave the agent 20% of his earnings. After the first contract had expired, the actor and the agent decided to continue working together. They photocopied their old contract, changed the date, and signed it. At the end of the year, a dispute arose as to what percentage of earnings the actor owed. It is a trade practice in the acting profession for actors to pay their agents 10% of their yearly earnings, payable at the end of the year.
What percentage of the actor's earnings is a court most likely to award the agent?

choices.a: 20%, because course of dealing is given greater weight than trade usage.
choices.b: 15%, because it was an express term of the contract.
choices.c: 10%, because trade usage is the applicable default rule.
choices.d: Nothing, because the contract is too indefinite.
