It is a trade practice in the acting profession for actors to pay their agents 10% of their yearly earnings, payable at the end of the year.

What percentage of the actor's earnings is a court most likely to award the agent?

一名刚从戏剧学校毕业的演员和一名经纪人签订了一份为期一年的书面合同，合同中描述了经纪人将提供的服务。由于急于找到工作，该演员在合同中同意向经纪人支付其年收入的15%。年终时，该演员对自己得到的众多角色非常满意，便向经纪人支付了其收入的20%。第一份合同到期后，该演员和经纪人决定继续合作。他们复印了旧合同，修改了日期，并签了字。年终时，双方就演员应支付的收入百分比产生了争议。演艺界的行业惯例是，演员在年终向其经纪人支付年收入的10%。

法院最有可能判给经纪人演员收入的百分之几？
options:
A. 20%, because course of dealing is given greater weight than trade usage.
20%，因为交易过程的权重高于行业惯例。

B. 15%, because it was an express term of the contract.
15%，因为这是合同的明示条款。

C. 10%, because trade usage is the applicable default rule.
10%，因为行业惯例是适用的默认规则。

D. Nothing, because the contract is too indefinite.
无，因为该合同过于不确定。
data.explanation:
Course of performance, course of dealing & trade usage


Course of performanceSequence of conduct that is relevant to understanding agreement between parties if: agreement involves repeated occasions for performance by one party AND other party accepts performance without objection
Course of dealingSequence of conduct concerning previous transactions between parties that establishes common basis of understanding for interpreting their conduct
Trade usagePractice or method of dealing in parties' business or industry that is observed with enough regularity to justify expectation that it will be observed in instant case
Courts adhere to rules of construction when interpreting contracts. The purpose of these rules is to assist the court in determining the meaning of ambiguous terms. Evidence relevant to this determination includes the contract's express terms, the parties' course of performance, the parties' course of dealing, and the industry's trade usage. When these are inconsistent with one another, priority is given as follows:

  • Express terms
  • Course of performance
  • Course of dealing
  • Trade usage


Here, the second contract executed by the actor and the agent expressly stated that the agent would receive 15% of the actor's yearly earnings. Although the actor gave 20% of his yearly earnings to the agent when the first contract ended, this was not a course of dealing between the parties because it occurred only once (Choice A). And even though the acting profession's practice is to pay agents 10% of yearly earnings, an express term is given greater weight than trade usage when they are inconsistent. Therefore, a court will likely award the agent 15% (Choice C).

(Choice D) A contract may be void if certain essential terms (eg, subject matter, consideration, duration) are indefinite. But here, the essential terms of the contract were not indefinite - ie, the subject matter was the agent's services, the consideration was 15% of the actor's yearly earnings, and the duration was one year.

Educational objective: In interpreting contracts,
  • express terms prevail over all others,
  • course of performance prevails over course of dealing and trade usage, and
  • course of dealing prevails over trade usage.


选项正确率统计：A选项 9%，B选项 88%（正确选项），C选项 2%，D选项 0%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

履约过程(Course of performance)、交易过程(course of dealing)与行业惯例(trade usage)


履约过程(Course of performance)如果协议涉及一方的重复履行，且另一方无异议地接受该履行，则该履约过程是与理解双方协议相关的系列行为。
交易过程(Course of dealing)双方之间先前交易的一系列行为，为解释其行为建立了共同的理解基础。
行业惯例(Trade usage)在当事方所属商业或行业中，被足够规律地遵守的实践或交易方法，以至于有理由期望在本案中也会被遵守。
法院在解释合同时遵循解释规则(rules of construction)。这些规则的目的是协助法院确定模糊条款的含义。与此裁定相关的证据包括合同的明示条款(express terms)、当事方的履约过程(course of performance)、当事方的交易过程(course of dealing)以及行业的行业惯例(trade usage)。当这些证据相互矛盾时，优先顺序如下：

  • 明示条款
  • 履约过程
  • 交易过程
  • 行业惯例


在本案中，演员和经纪人签订的第二份合同明确规定，经纪人将获得演员年收入的15%。尽管在第一份合同结束时，演员向经纪人支付了其年收入的20%，但这并不构成双方之间的交易过程，因为它只发生过一次（选项A）。而且，尽管演艺界的惯例是向经纪人支付10%的年收入，但在明示条款与行业惯例不一致时，明示条款具有更高的权重。因此，法院很可能判给经纪人15%（选项C）。

（选项D）如果某些基本条款（例如，标的物、对价、期限）不确定，合同可能无效。但在本案中，合同的基本条款并非不确定——即，标的物是经纪人的服务，对价是演员年收入的15%，期限为一年。

教学目标：在解释合同时，
  • 明示条款优先于所有其他证据，
  • 履约过程优先于交易过程和行业惯例，以及
  • 交易过程优先于行业惯例。


References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 203 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (rules of construction to interpret a contract).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Interpretation & Hierarchy
正确答案：选项 B (15%)
理由：明示条款 (Express Terms) 的效力高于行业惯例和交易过程。
⚖️ 法律核心规则

本题考查的是合同解释中不同证据来源的优先顺位 (Hierarchy of Interpretation)。根据《合同法重述（第二版）》(Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 203) 和 UCC 的规定，当合同条款含义不清或各证据相互冲突时，法院遵循以下优先顺序：

1
明示条款 (Express Terms)
合同中实际写下的文字。
2
履约过程 (Course of Performance)
本次合同中，双方已经履行的行为。
3
交易过程 (Course of Dealing)
双方在之前的合同中建立的行为模式。
4
行业惯例 (Trade Usage)
该行业普遍遵守的规则。
🔍 案情分析

在本案中，我们需要对比三个相互冲突的证据：

  • 明示条款：新合同是旧合同的复印件，明确写着 15%。
  • 交易过程：去年演员支付了 20%（尽管只发生了一次，通常不足以构成"Course"，但即使构成，顺位也较低）。
  • 行业惯例：行业标准是 10%。

结论：根据优先顺位规则，明示条款 (Express Terms) 具有最高效力。无论行业惯例如何，或者去年发生了什么，只要双方在新的书面合同中明确约定了 15%，该条款就排除了其他默认规则。

❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
  • 选项 A (20%)：错误。首先，一次性的支付通常不足以建立“交易过程 (Course of Dealing)”。其次，即使它是交易过程，明示条款 (15%) 的效力依然高于交易过程。
  • 选项 C (10%)：错误。行业惯例 (Trade Usage) 处于解释层级的最底端。它仅在填补合同空白或解释模糊术语时有用。当它与明示条款冲突时，明示条款优先。
  • 选项 D (合同不确定)：错误。合同具备了所有基本要素：主体 (Parties)、标的 (Subject Matter - 代理服务)、价格 (Price - 15%) 和期限 (Duration - 1年)。合同是明确且可执行的。

在女儿上第一节课之前，店主与市交响乐团签订了演奏合同，并通知所有客户她将不再提供私人课程。

如果父亲以违约为由起诉店主，他是否可能胜诉？

A. No, because the parties' agreement regarding the music lessons is inconsistent with the express language of the written contract.

data.explanation:
A written contract that contains a merger clause is presumed to be completely integrated - ie, a final expression of the parties' agreement as to all terms. As a result, the parol evidence rule generally bars any evidence of prior or contemporaneous agreements or negotiations, regardless of whether they are consistent with the terms of the contract as written. But this rule does not apply when such evidence is offered to prove the existence of a collateral agreement - ie, a separate contract supported by separate consideration.

Here, the written contract for the sale of the violin contained a merger clause (complete integration presumed). However, the parties' contemporaneous oral agreement regarding violin lessons created a separate contract that was supported by separate consideration (ie, lessons in exchange for $50 per lesson). As a result, the parol evidence rule does not bar evidence of this collateral agreement. And since the store owner repudiated the agreement by notifying the father that she would no longer be providing the lessons, he will likely prevail.

(Choice A) The written contract was silent as to music lessons, so the parties' oral agreement regarding the music lessons was consistent with (ie, did not contradict) the express language of the written contract.

(Choice B) Under the statute of frauds, a contract for the sale of goods for $500 or more must be in writing to be enforceable. But this would not prevent the father from prevailing in his breach-of-contract claim for the store owner's failure to provide a service (violin lessons).

(Choice C) Parol evidence is admissible to prove the existence of consistent additional terms only if the contract at issue is partially integrated - ie, a final expression as to some, but not all, of the terms (not seen here). But evidence of the parties' oral agreement is still admissible here because it represents a collateral agreement.

Educational objective: Even where a contract is completely integrated (eg, as evidenced by a merger clause), parol evidence can be used to prove the existence of a separate collateral agreement supported by its own consideration.

包含完整协议条款（merger clause）的书面合同被推定为完全整合的——即，双方就所有条款达成协议的最终表述。因此，parol evidence rule通常排除任何先前或同期的协议或协商的证据，无论其是否与书面合同的条款相符。但当该证据被用于证明存在附属协议（collateral agreement）——即，由独立的对价支持的独立合同时，此规则不适用。

在此案中，小提琴销售的书面合同包含了完整协议条款（推定为完全整合）。然而，双方同期达成的关于小提琴课程的口头协议构成了一份独立的合同，该合同有独立的对价支持（即，以每节课50美元换取课程）。因此，parol evidence rule不排除这份附属协议的证据。并且，由于店主通知父亲她将不再提供课程，从而拒绝履行协议，父亲很可能会胜诉。

(选项 A) 书面合同对音乐课程一事未作规定，因此双方关于音乐课程的口头协议与书面合同的明示语言是一致的（即不矛盾）。

(选项 B) 根据statute of frauds，价值500美元或以上的货物销售合同必须以书面形式订立才可强制执行。但这并不妨碍父亲就店主未能提供服务（小提琴课程）的违约行为提起诉讼并胜诉。

(选项 C) 只有当争议合同是部分整合的——即，仅对部分而非全部条款作出的最终表述时（本案情况并非如此），口头证据才可被采纳用以证明存在相符的附加条款。但在本案中，双方口头协议的证据仍然可以被采纳，因为它代表了一份附属协议。

教学目标：即使在合同是完全整合的情况下（例如，有完整协议条款为证），口头证据也可以用来证明存在一个由其自身对价支持的、独立的附属协议。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 216 cmt. c (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that a collateral contract is not barred by an integrated one).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Parol Evidence Rule
正确答案：D 会胜诉，因为双方关于音乐课程的协议是附属于小提琴销售合同的附属协议 (Collateral Agreement)。
⚖️ 核心法律规则解析

本题考察的是合同法中的口头证据规则 (Parol Evidence Rule, PER) 及其例外情况。

基本规则

当双方将协议简化为书面形式，并意图将其作为最终且完整的协议表达（即完全整合 Completely Integrated）时，PER 禁止引入任何先前或同期的口头协议来反驳或补充书面合同。

本题中，合同包含完整协议条款 (Merger Clause)，通常推定合同为完全整合。

关键例外：附属协议 (Collateral Agreement)

即使主合同是完全整合的，如果口头协议满足以下条件，PER 不禁止其证据的引入：

  1. 协议是附属的 (Collateral)：即在形式上是独立的；
  2. 与书面合同不冲突；
  3. 不是双方通常会包含在主合同中的内容。
🔍 案情具体分析

为什么父亲会胜诉？

  • 独立的对价 (Separate Consideration)： 父亲买琴付了 $1,500；课程是每节 $50。课程协议有其独立的支付对价，不包含在买琴的款项中。
  • 不同的标的物： 书面合同是关于货物销售 (Sale of Goods)，而口头协议是关于服务 (Services)。
  • 结论： 课程协议被视为一个独立的、附属的合同 (Collateral Contract)。书面合同中的 Merger Clause 仅旨在整合关于“买琴”的协议，不能通过一句话抹杀双方同时达成的另一个独立的服务合同。
❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
选项 A 错误

理由： 书面合同对课程只字未提（沉默），这并不构成“不一致” (Inconsistent)。不一致通常指口头证据与书面条款直接相悖。

选项 B 错误

理由： 涉及 Statute of Frauds (SOF)。
1. 课程协议是服务合同，期限为6个月（少于1年），不需要书面形式。
2. 虽然买琴超过$500需要书面，但琴的合同已经书面化了。SOF 不阻碍课程协议的执行。

选项 C 错误

理由： 这是一个极具迷惑性的选项。
如果合同被视为完全整合 (Fully Integrated)，则即使是补充性的一致条款 (Consistent Additional Terms) 也是不可采纳的。选项 C 的表述混淆了规则（只有在部分整合 Partially Integrated 时，才允许引入补充条款）。本题的突破口在于它是一个“附属协议”，而非仅仅是主合同的“补充条款”。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

在处理 Parol Evidence Rule 题目时，如果看到书面合同有 Merger Clause，但口头协议涉及完全不同的标的（如本题的“买货” vs “买课”）且有独立的对价，请优先考虑 Collateral Agreement 例外。这通常意味着口头协议有效。

If the beverage company sues the manufacturer for breach of their contract, which of the following facts, if established, would most strengthen the beverage company's case?

When the landowner's son learned of the agreement, acting as his father's court-appointed guardian, he sought to have the sale set aside. Will the court likely admit evidence of the prior conversations between the landowner and the buyer?

If the court finds the contract to be completely integrated, is the president's offered evidence admissible?

一份书面建筑合同以如下序言开始：“本协议，由一家房地产公司（下称‘业主’）与一家建筑公司及其总裁（下称‘承包商’）签订，特此为证：” 合同的签名格式如下：房地产公司，由其总裁（签名）；建筑公司，由其副总裁（签名）和总裁（签名）作为建筑公司的代表。

建筑公司后来资不抵债并违约。房地产公司以个人名义起诉建筑公司总裁违约，在审判中，该总裁提供了来自合同前谈判的证据，证明只有建筑公司才对履行合同负有法律责任。

options:
A. No, because of the application of the "four corners" rule, under which the meaning of a completely integrated contract must be ascertained solely from its own terms.
否，因为适用“四角规则”（four corners rule），根据该规则，一份完全整合合同的含义必须仅从其自身条款中确定。

B. No, because the legal effect of the president's signature cannot be altered by evidence of prior understandings.
否，因为总裁签字的法律效力不能通过先前谅解的证据来改变。

C. Yes, because the evidence would contradict neither the recital nor the form of the president's signature.
是，因为该证据既不与合同序言相矛盾，也不与总裁的签字形式相矛盾。

D. Yes, because the writing is ambiguous as to whether or not the president was intended individually to be a contracting party.
是，因为书面文件对于总裁是否意图以个人身份成为合同方这一点上存在模糊不清之处。
data.explanation:
Exceptions to parol evidence rule Evidence of prior or contemporaneous oral or written agreement is admissible to establish:
  • whether writing is integrated and, if so, completely or partially
  • meaning of ambiguous term
  • defense to formation or enforcement (eg, fraud, duress, mistake)
  • ground for granting or denying remedy (eg, rescission, reformation)
  • subsequent contract modifications
  • condition precedent to effectiveness
The parol evidence rule generally bars evidence of prior or contemporaneous oral or written agreements - or other evidence outside the "four corners" of the contract - to modify or contradict the terms of an integrated writing. But the parol evidence rule does not bar such evidence, and such evidence is always admissible, when it is used to clarify the meaning of an ambiguous contract term. This is true regardless of whether the contract is completely or partially integrated.

Here, the recital indicates that the construction company and its president are parties to the contract (together, "the contractor"), while the signature lines show the president signing merely as a representative of the company. This shows that the writing is ambiguous as to whether the president was intended individually to be a contracting party. Therefore, evidence from the parties' pre-contract negotiations is admissible to clarify the terms of the written contract.

(Choice A) A court does not have to rely solely on the "four corners" of a written contract to determine its meaning. Extrinsic evidence such as the parties' pre-contract negotiations can be used to interpret ambiguous terms.

(Choice B) The legal effect of the president's signature can be altered by evidence of prior understandings because the signature creates ambiguity regarding the contract's terms (eg, whether the president - as an individual - is a contracting party).

(Choice C) Evidence that only the construction company was to be legally responsible would contradict the recital since the recital identifies both the company and the president as parties. But since the signature lines suggest that the president is not a party, evidence of the parties' pre- contract negotiations is admissible to clarify the ambiguity.

Educational objective: The parol evidence rule does not bar evidence of prior or contemporaneous agreements when it is being offered to establish the meaning of an ambiguous term.

口头证据规则的例外情况 先前的或同期的口头或书面协议的证据，在用于证明以下事项时可被采纳：
  • 书面文件是否是整合的，如果是，是完全整合还是部分整合
  • 模糊条款的含义
  • 对合同成立或执行的抗辩（例如，欺诈、胁迫、错误）
  • 批准或拒绝救济的理由（例如，合同解除、合同修改）
  • 随后的合同修改
  • 合同生效的先决条件
口头证据规则（parol evidence rule）通常禁止使用先前的或同期的口头或书面协议——或其他在合同“四角”之外的证据——来修改或反驳一份整合书面文件的条款。但是，当该证据被用来澄清一个模糊合同条款的含义时，口头证据规则不禁止此类证据，且此类证据总是可被采纳的。无论合同是完全整合还是部分整合，这一点都成立。

在本案中，序言表明建筑公司及其总裁是合同的当事人（合称为“承包商”），而签名栏则显示总裁仅作为公司的代表签字。这表明书面文件对于总裁是否意图以个人身份成为合同方这一点上存在模糊不清之处。因此，来自双方合同前谈判的证据是可以被采纳的，以澄清书面合同的条款。

(选项A) 法院不必仅仅依赖书面合同的“四角”来确定其含义。诸如双方合同前谈判之类的外部证据可用于解释模糊条款。

(选项B) 总裁签字的法律效力可以通过先前谅解的证据来改变，因为该签字就合同条款（例如，总裁是否以个人身份作为合同方）造成了模糊性。

(选项C) 只有建筑公司承担法律责任的证据将会与序言相矛盾，因为序言将公司和总裁两者都认定为当事人。但由于签名栏表明总裁并非当事人，因此来自双方合同前谈判的证据可以被采纳，以澄清此模糊之处。

教学目标：当为证明模糊条款的含义而提供先前的或同期的协议证据时，口头证据规则不禁止该证据的采纳。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 214 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (prior negotiations are admissible to explain meaning of ambiguous term).

MBE 合同法考点解析

Parol Evidence Rule & Ambiguity
🔑 核心考点 (Key Principle) 即使合同是完全整合 (Completely Integrated) 的，口头证据规则 (Parol Evidence Rule) 也不禁止引入外部证据来解释合同中的歧义 (Ambiguity)。
案情逻辑分析

本题的核心矛盾在于合同书面文件内部的不一致性（Internal Inconsistency）：

  • 序言 (Recital)： 明确指出“总裁”个人也是合同一方（"Contractor" includes the president）。这暗示了个人责任。
  • 签名栏 (Signature Block)： 总裁的签名显示他仅作为“公司的代表” (as representatives)。这通常意味着仅有公司责任，没有个人责任。

这种书面文件内部的冲突创造了明显的歧义 (Patent Ambiguity)：总裁到底是不是合同的当事人？

✅ 正确答案解析 (选项 D)
正确答案 D

理由： 书面文件对于总裁是否意图以个人身份成为合同方存在模糊不清。

法律推理：

虽然法院认定合同是“完全整合”的（意味着不能引入证据来增加或修改条款），但法律允许引入外部证据（如谈判记录）来解释 (Interpret) 模糊的条款。

因为序言和签名栏的矛盾，合同本身对于“谁是责任方”这一关键条款含义不清。因此，总裁提供的证据不是为了“改变”合同，而是为了“澄清”这一模糊点，所以是可采纳的 (Admissible)。

❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
选项 A (四角规则)

错误点： “四角规则” (Four Corners Rule) 并不绝对禁止解释歧义。当合同表面出现明显矛盾时，法院必须查看外部证据来确定当事人的真实意图，而不能仅凭文件本身猜测。

选项 B (签名效力)

错误点： 虽然签名通常具有决定性，但本案中签名的形式（代表公司）与序言（个人作为当事人）冲突。这种冲突本身就是允许引入证据的理由。

选项 C (不矛盾)

错误点： 这是一个陷阱选项。选项 C 结论是“可以采纳”，但理由错误。证据显示“只有公司负责”，这实际上确实反驳 (Contradict) 了序言中“总裁是当事人”的陈述。证据之所以被采纳，不是因为它不矛盾，而是因为合同本身有歧义。

💡 MBE 考试技巧 (Exam Tip) 在处理 Parol Evidence Rule 题目时，请遵循以下步骤：
  1. 检查合同是否为整合 (Integrated) 的。
  2. 如果是，通常禁止外部证据。
  3. 但是！ 立即寻找例外情况 (Exceptions)：
    • 解释歧义 (Ambiguity) —— 本题考点
    • 证明合同无效 (如欺诈 Fraud, 胁迫 Duress)
    • 先决条件 (Condition Precedent)
如果题目中出现了合同条款的前后不一，选“允许引入证据以解释歧义”通常是正确方向。

买方随后拒绝接受飞机交付。飞机公司试图根据违约金条款兑现该支票，但代理人已发出了止付令。飞机公司起诉买方，要求其偿还1万美元。买方提供了代理人的证词，称销售人员在谈判期间口头同意，在买方妻子批准之前，交易不会最终敲定，而她并未批准。

options:
A. No, because the merger clause bars any evidence of the parties' prior discussions concerning the sale of the plane.

B. No, because the testimony contradicts the writing by making the parties' duties conditional.
不应采纳，因为该证词通过将双方的义务设定为有条件的，从而与书面合同相矛盾。

C. Yes, because the testimony is being introduced to prove a condition precedent to the contract's enforceability.
应采纳，因为该证词是为了证明合同可执行性的一个先决条件。

Parol Evidence Rule & Exceptions


RuleBars extrinsic evidence of a prior or contemporaneous agreement that contradicts a later writing intended as a final and complete expression of the agreement.
ExceptionsExtrinsic evidence is admissible to:
  • Clarify ambiguity (interpret the writing)
  • Show a defense to formation (e.g., fraud, duress)
  • Establish a condition precedent to the enforceability of the contract
  • Show subsequent modifications
While the parol evidence rule generally bars extrinsic evidence that alters the terms of an integrated written contract (especially one with a merger clause), it does not bar evidence offered to prove that a written agreement was subject to a condition precedent to its enforceability. A condition precedent is an event that must occur before a party's duty to perform under a contract becomes absolute. The law allows evidence of such a condition because it does not contradict the terms of the writing, but rather explains the circumstances under which the written agreement becomes operative.

Here, the agent's testimony is offered to prove that the parties orally agreed that their duties to perform would not become absolute until the buyer's wife approved the deal. This is a classic condition precedent.

(Choice C) This is the correct answer. It accurately states the applicable exception to the parol evidence rule. The testimony is admissible to prove that the entire contract's enforceability was conditioned on the wife's approval, an event that did not occur. Thus, the buyer's duty to perform never arose.

(Choice A & B) These are incorrect. A merger clause and the rule against contradictions do not bar evidence of a condition precedent to the enforceability of the entire contract. This exception allows evidence that might otherwise seem contradictory because it does not alter the written terms of the agreement, but rather the conditions for the agreement's performance.

(Choice D) This is incorrect. While evidence can sometimes be admitted to prove partial integration, the primary and most direct reason for admitting this specific testimony is the condition precedent exception, which is a more precise fit for these facts.

选项正确率统计：A选项 20%，B选项 19%，C选项 50%（正确选项），D选项 9%

口头证据规则及其例外


规则禁止采纳与一份旨在作为协议最终且完整表达的书面文件相矛盾的、先前的或同期的协议的外部证据。
例外外部证据在以下情况可被采纳：
  • 澄清歧义（解释书面文件）
  • 证明存在合同成立的抗辩理由（例如，欺诈、胁迫）
  • 确立合同可执行性的先决条件
  • 证明后续的修改
尽管口头证据规则通常禁止采纳改变一份完整书面合同（尤其是有合并条款的合同）条款的外部证据，但它不禁止为证明一份书面协议受制于其可执行性的先决条件（condition precedent to its enforceability）而提出的证据。先决条件是指在一个合同当事人的履行义务变为绝对之前必须发生的事件。法律允许关于此类条件的证据，因为它并未反驳书面合同的条款，而是解释了该书面协议在何种情况下才开始生效。

在本案中，代理人的证词是为了证明双方曾口头约定，他们在书面合同下的履行义务直到买方妻子批准交易后才成为绝对义务。这是一个典型的先决条件。

(选项C) 这是正确答案。它准确地陈述了口头证据规则的适用例外。该证词可以被采纳，以证明整个合同的可执行性取决于妻子的批准，而这一事件并未发生。因此，买方的履行义务从未产生。

(选项A和B) 这两个选项是错误的。合并条款和反驳规则并不能排除关于整个合同可执行性的先决条件的证据。这个例外之所以允许采纳看似矛盾的证据，是因为它并不改变协议的书面条款，而是改变协议履行的条件。

(选项D) 这是不正确的。尽管有时可以为证明部分整合而采纳证据，但在本案中，采纳该特定证词最主要、最直接的理由是先决条件例外，这与案件事实更精确地吻合。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 214 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (exceptions to parol evidence rule).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Parol Evidence Rule
正确答案：选项 C

应采纳，因为该证词是为了证明合同可执行性的一个先决条件 (Condition Precedent)。

核心考点：口头证据规则的例外

口头证据规则 (Parol Evidence Rule, PER) 通常禁止引入与书面合同相矛盾的外部证据，特别是当合同包含合并条款 (Merger Clause) 时。

关键例外：

PER 不禁止引入证据来证明合同的生效受制于某个先决条件 (Condition Precedent to Effectiveness)。

如果双方口头同意书面合同在特定事件发生前不生效，这种证据是可采纳的，因为它不是在修改合同条款，而是在证明合同尚未产生法律效力。

本案逻辑推演
1. 识别障碍：
合同是书面的，且有合并条款。通常这意味着不能引入之前的口头协议。
2. 分析证据性质：
买方试图证明：销售员口头同意“在妻子批准前，交易不最终敲定”。
3. 适用规则：
“妻子批准”是一个生效先决条件。如果妻子不批准，合同义务从未产生。
4. 结论：
根据 Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 217，即使有完全整合的书面合同，证明“合同生效取决于某一口头条件”的证据也是可采纳的 (Admissible)。
为什么其他选项错误？
❌ 选项 A (合并条款)：
虽然合并条款通常表明合同是完整的，但它不能阻止证明合同根本没有生效的证据。合并条款只保护有效的合同内容不被篡改，不保护无效的合同。
❌ 选项 B (矛盾)：
法律认为，证明“合同尚未生效”并不构成与“合同条款”的矛盾。它攻击的是合同的可执行性 (Enforceability)，而不是合同的具体内容（如价格、型号）。
❌ 选项 D (部分整合)：
虽然部分整合 (Partial Integration) 允许补充一致的附加条款，但本案最直接的法律依据是“先决条件例外”。即使合同是完全整合的 (Fully Integrated)，先决条件证据依然可采纳。
💡 MBE 拿分技巧

当你看到题目中出现：

  • 书面合同 + 合并条款 (Merger Clause)
  • 一方声称有口头协议说 "Subject to..." (取决于...) 或 "Not effective until..." (直到...才生效)

直接寻找“Condition Precedent” (先决条件) 的选项。

这是 PER 规则中最常考的例外之一。记住：你可以用口头证据来证明合同从未“活”过来。

A business made an agreement in writing with a shareholder to purchase all of her stock in a corporation at a specified price per share. At the time the agreement was executed, the business said to the shareholder, "Our commitment to buy is conditioned on first obtaining approval of the purchase agreement from our parent company." The shareholder replied, "That will not be a problem." The shareholder is willing and ready to consummate the sale of her stock to the business, but the business refuses to perform on the ground (which is true) that the parent company has firmly refused to approve the contract.
If the shareholder sues the business for breach of contract and seeks to exclude any evidence of the oral condition requiring the parent company's approval, how will the court likely rule?

choices.a: Admit the evidence as proof of a collateral agreement.
choices.b: Admit the evidence as proof of a condition to the existence of an enforceable obligation, and therefore not within the scope of the parol evidence rule.
choices.c: Exclude the evidence as contradicting the terms of the parties' written agreement, whether or not the writing was a complete integration of the contract.
choices.d: Exclude the evidence on the basis of a finding that the parties' written agreement was a complete integration of their contract.

一家企业与一名股东达成书面协议，以特定单价购买其在一家公司持有的所有股份。协议签订时，该企业对股东说：'我们的购买承诺，是以首先获得我们母公司对该购买协议的批准为条件的。'股东回答说：'那不会有问题。'该股东愿意并准备好与该企业完成其股份的出售，但该企业以其母公司已明确拒绝批准该合同为由（该理由属实）拒绝履行合同。

如果该股东以违约为由起诉该企业，并试图排除任何关于要求母公司批准的口头条件的证据，法院可能会如何裁决？
options:
A. Admit the evidence as proof of a collateral agreement.
采纳该证据，作为附属协议的证明。

B. Admit the evidence as proof of a condition to the existence of an enforceable obligation, and therefore not within the scope of the parol evidence rule.
采纳该证据，作为可强制执行义务存在的前提条件的证明，因此不在 parol evidence rule 的范围内。

C. Exclude the evidence as contradicting the terms of the parties' written agreement, whether or not the writing was a complete integration of the contract.
排除该证据，因为其与双方书面协议的条款相矛盾，无论该书面文件是否为合同的完全整合。

D. Exclude the evidence on the basis of a finding that the parties' written agreement was a complete integration of their contract.
基于双方书面协议已构成其合同的完全整合这一裁定，排除该证据。
data.explanation:
Exceptions to parol evidence rule Evidence of prior or contemporaneous oral or written agreement is admissible to establish:
  • whether writing is integrated and, if so, completely or partially
  • meaning of ambiguous term
  • defense to formation or enforcement (eg, fraud, duress, mistake)
  • ground for granting or denying remedy (eg, rescission, reformation)
  • subsequent contract modifications
  • condition precedent to effectiveness
The parol evidence rule generally bars evidence of a prior or contemporaneous agreement to modify or contradict the terms of an integrated writing. But this rule does not apply when a party is attacking the validity of the agreement - eg, by asserting there was a condition precedent to effectiveness that failed to occur. As a result, evidence of such a condition precedent is admissible.

Here, the parties orally agreed that the business would be committed to buy the stock (ie, the purchase agreement would take effect) only if the parent company approved the agreement - a condition precedent to effectiveness. Therefore, the parol evidence rule does not apply, and evidence of the oral condition is admissible to prove that the purchase agreement failed to take effect because the parent company refused to approve it.

(Choice A) Evidence of the oral condition is not evidence of a collateral agreement - ie, one that is related to the subject matter of the contract but not part of its primary promise. That is because the oral condition is part of the primary purpose of the agreement - ie, the purchase of the stock.

(Choices C & D) The contract was a partial integration because it set forth the parties' final agreement about some, but not all, terms. But regardless of whether the contract was a complete or partial integration, the oral agreement is admissible because it evidences a condition precedent to effectiveness.

Educational objective: Evidence used to establish a condition precedent that must occur before a contract becomes effective is admissible under the parol evidence rule.

parol evidence rule 的例外情况 在先的或同期的口头或书面协议的证据可以被采纳以证明：
  • 书面文件是否为整合协议，以及如果是，是完全整合还是部分整合
  • 不明确条款的含义
  • 合同成立或执行的抗辩（例如，欺诈、胁迫、错误）
  • 批准或拒绝救济的理由（例如，撤销、修正）
  • 后续的合同修改
  • 合同生效的先决条件
parol evidence rule 通常禁止采纳在先的或同期的协议证据，以修改或反驳整合书面文件的条款。但是，当一方当事人攻击协议的有效性时——例如，主张存在一个未发生的合同生效先决条件时，该规则不适用。因此，关于此类先决条件的证据是可被采纳的。

在本案中，双方口头约定，只有在母公司批准协议的情况下，该企业才有义务购买股份（即购买协议才会生效）——这是一个合同生效的先决条件。因此，parol evidence rule 不适用，关于口头条件的证据可以被采纳，以证明购买协议因母公司拒绝批准而未能生效。

(选项A) 口头条件的证据并非附属协议的证据——即，与合同标的物相关但并非其主要承诺一部分的协议。这是因为该口头条件是协议主要目的的一部分——即购买股份。

(选项C和D) 该合同是一个部分整合，因为它规定了双方就部分而非全部条款达成的最终协议。但无论合同是完全整合还是部分整合，该口头协议都是可以被采纳的，因为它证明了合同生效的先决条件。

教学目标： 用于证明在合同生效前必须发生的先决条件的证据，在 parol evidence rule 下是可被采纳的。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 217 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (integrated agreement subject to oral requirement).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Parol Evidence Rule
核心法律原则

口头证据规则 (Parol Evidence Rule, PER) 通常禁止引入在书面合同签订之前或当时的口头协议来改变书面条款。但是，该规则有一个极其重要的例外：

如果口头证据是为了证明合同的生效先决条件 (Condition Precedent to Effectiveness)，则该证据可以被采纳。

案情逻辑分析

本案中，虽然买卖双方签署了书面协议，但在签署时，企业明确提出了一个口头条件：

"我们的购买承诺，是以首先获得我们母公司对该购买协议的批准为条件的。"

这属于典型的生效先决条件 (Condition Precedent)。这意味着：除非母公司批准，否则合同义务根本不产生（或合同不生效）。

既然母公司拒绝批准，该条件未满足，合同义务未产生。企业引入该证据不是为了“修改”合同条款，而是为了证明合同从未生效。

选项深度解析
正确答案 B

采纳该证据。

理由：该证据证明了存在一个可强制执行义务产生的先决条件。根据 Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 217，证明合同生效条件的证据不在 Parol Evidence Rule 的排除范围内。

选项 C & D 错误

理由：这两个选项都试图应用 PER 来排除证据。无论书面合同是完全整合 (Complete Integration) 还是部分整合 (Partial Integration)，PER 都不禁止引入关于“合同是否有效成立”的证据。整合程度只在试图增加或补充条款时才重要，而在攻击合同本身的有效性时（如本案），整合程度无关紧要。

选项 A 错误

理由：这并非附属协议 (Collateral Agreement)。附属协议通常指与主合同标的相关的另一个独立协议。本案中的口头条件直接关系到主合同是否生效，属于生效条件，而非附属协议。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理 Parol Evidence Rule 问题时，请遵循以下步骤：

  1. 看目的：引入证据的一方想干什么？
  2. 如果是为了解释 (Explain) 模糊条款 -> 允许。
  3. 如果是为了证明合同无效/未生效 (Invalidity/Non-effectiveness)（如欺诈、胁迫、生效先决条件） -> 允许。
  4. 如果是为了修改/补充 (Modify/Add) 条款 -> 此时才需要考虑书面文件是否为“完全整合”。

本题属于第3种情况，直接允许，无需考虑整合程度。

A. No, because the seller timely objected to the buyer's proposal for different terms.

B. No, because the writing contained the complete and exclusive agreement of the parties.

C. Yes, because a modification made in good faith does not require consideration.

D. Yes, because evidence of course of dealing is admissible even if the writing contains the complete and exclusive agreement of the parties.
可以，因为即使书面文件包含了双方完整且排他的协议，交易习惯的证据也是可采纳的。
data.explanation:
Under the UCC parol evidence rule, evidence of a prior agreement (or contemporaneous oral agreement) cannot be used to contradict the terms of a final written agreement. But the following evidence can be used to explain or supplement those terms, regardless of whether the agreement is completely or partially integrated:†

  • Course of performance - sequence of conduct that is relevant to understanding an agreement between the parties if (1) the agreement involves repeated occasions for performance by a party and (2) the other party accepts performance without objection
  • Course of dealing - sequence of conduct concerning previous transactions between the parties that establishes a common basis of understanding for interpreting their conduct
  • Trade usage - any practice or method of dealing in the parties' business or industry that is practiced with enough regularity to justify an expectation that it will be practiced in the instant case


Here, on several past occasions, the buyer had taken a 5% discount from the contract price when paying within 10 days of delivery, and the seller had not objected. This established a course of dealing between the parties that can be used to supplement the contract at issue, which was silent regarding discounts for early payment. Therefore, evidence of the 5% discount is admissible even if the writing contains the complete and exclusive agreement of the parties (ie, even if the writing is completely integrated) (Choice B).

†Priority is given as follows: (1) express contractual terms prevail over all others, (2) course of performance prevails over course of dealing and trade usage, and (3) course of dealing prevails over trade usage.

(Choice A) There was an established course of dealing between the parties, so the seller's objection to the 5% discount - after the buyer had acted in accordance with the course of dealing - was ineffective.

(Choice C) Under the UCC, a good-faith modification is enforceable without consideration. But the enforceability of a modification is not at issue here.

Educational objective: The UCC parol evidence rule always allows course of performance, course of dealing, and trade usage to be used to explain or supplement the terms of a final written agreement - even one that is completely integrated.

根据《统一商法典》(UCC) 的口头证据规则，先前协议（或同期口头协议）的证据不能被用来抵触最终书面协议的条款。但是，以下证据可以被用来解释或补充这些条款，无论该协议是完全整合的还是部分整合的：†

  • 履约过程 (Course of performance) - 指可用于理解协议的系列行为，条件是 (1) 协议涉及一方的重复履约，且 (2) 另一方无异议地接受该履约。
  • 交易习惯 (Course of dealing) - 指双方在先前交易中的一系列行为，为解释其本次行为建立了一个共同的理解基础。
  • 行业惯例 (Trade usage) - 双方业务或行业中的任何实践或交易方法，其应用具有足够的规律性，以至于有理由期望在本案中也会被遵守。


在本案中，在过去的几次交易中，买方在交货后10天内付款时，都从合同价格中扣除了5%的折扣，而卖方并未提出异议。这在双方之间建立了一种交易习惯，可以用来补充本案所涉的合同，而该合同对提前付款的折扣问题保持沉默。因此，关于5%折扣的证据是可采纳的，即使书面文件包含了双方完整且排他的协议（即，即使该书面文件是完全整合的）(选项B)。

†效力优先顺序如下：(1) 明示的合同条款优先于所有其他证据，(2) 履约过程优先于交易习惯和行业惯例，以及 (3) 交易习惯优先于行业惯例。

(选项A) 双方之间已存在既定的交易习惯，因此，在买方按照该交易习惯行事之后，卖方对5%折扣提出的异议是无效的。

(选项C) 根据《统一商法典》(UCC)，善意的修改无需对价即可强制执行。但修改的可执行性并非本案的争议点。

MBE 考点解析：UCC 合同解释
正确答案：D

是的，因为即使书面文件包含了双方完整且排他的协议，交易习惯 (Course of Dealing) 的证据也是可采纳的。

核心考点：UCC 口头证据规则

本题考察的是《统一商法典》(UCC) 第 2-202 条关于口头证据规则 (Parol Evidence Rule) 的特殊规定。

UCC 规则要点：
即使一份书面合同被声明为“完整且排他的协议” (Complete and Exclusive Integration)，以下三类证据永远可以被引入用来解释或补充合同条款：
  1. 履约过程 (Course of Performance)
    本次合同中双方的重复行为。
  2. 交易习惯 (Course of Dealing)
    双方在过去交易中的行为模式。
  3. 行业惯例 (Trade Usage)
    该行业内普遍遵守的做法。
本案法律分析

1. 适用法律：复印机是货物 (Goods)，因此适用 UCC。
2. 事实认定：买卖双方在“过去的几次交易中”一直允许5%的折扣。这构成了交易习惯 (Course of Dealing)。
3. 法律适用：虽然合同中有“完整协议条款” (Merger Clause)，但这不能阻止引入交易习惯来解释合同中关于付款的沉默部分。

因此，买方可以引入过去允许打折的证据，证明这是双方默认的协议一部分。

⚠️ 常见陷阱 (选项 B)
很多考生会误选 B，认为“完整协议条款” (Merger Clause) 会排除所有外部证据。

区别点：在普通法 (Common Law) 下，完全整合的合同确实很难引入外部证据。但在 UCC 下，立法者认为“交易背景”是合同本身的一部分，因此即使合同写得再绝，也不能排除上述三类解释性证据。
考试技巧总结

在 MBE 合同法题目中，如果看到：

  • 涉及货物买卖 (UCC)；
  • 合同是书面的且看起来很正式；
  • 但是双方有过去的交易历史或行业惯例；

请记住：UCC 极其倾向于允许引入这些背景证据，除非合同中明确用文字否定了该特定的习惯（例如明确写着“过去的所有折扣惯例均不适用”）。仅靠通用的“完整协议条款”是无法屏蔽交易习惯的。

3月1日，一位房主就其房屋的扩建事宜联系了一位建筑商。建筑商口头要约，如果其在另一项目上的待决投标被拒绝，他将以20万美元的价格承接这项工程。房主接受了建筑商的条款，随后建筑商准备了一份书面合同，双方均已签署。该合同并未提及建筑商的待决投标。一周后，建筑商得知其在另一项目上的待决投标已被接受，便拒绝为房主履行任何工作。

房主能否因建筑商的不履行行为获得赔偿？
options:
A. No, because efficiency principles justify the builder's services being directed to a higher-value use.
不能，因为效率原则证明了将建筑商的服务用于更高价值的用途是正当的。

B. No, because the builder's duty to perform was subject to a condition.
不能，因为建筑商的履行义务受限于一项条件。

C. Yes, because the builder's attempt to condition his duty to perform rendered the contract illusory.
能，因为建筑商试图为其履行义务附加条件的行为使合同变为虚幻。

D. Yes, because the parol evidence rule would bar the builder from presenting evidence of oral understandings not included in the final writing.
能，因为 parol evidence rule 将禁止建筑商提供未包含在最终书面文件中的口头谅解作为证据。
data.explanation:
Exceptions to parol evidence rule


Evidence of prior or contemporaneous oral or written agreement is admissible to establish:



  • whether writing is integrated and, if so, completely or partially

  • meaning of ambiguous term

  • defense to formation or enforcement (eg, fraud, duress, mistake)

  • ground for granting or denying remedy (eg, rescission, reformation)

  • subsequent contract modifications

  • condition precedent to effectiveness


The parol evidence rule generally bars evidence of a prior or contemporaneous agreement to modify or contradict the terms of an integrated writing. But this rule does not apply when a party is attacking the validity of the agreement - eg, by asserting there was a condition precedent to effectiveness that failed to occur. As a result, evidence of such a condition precedent is admissible.


Here, before the contract was signed, the parties orally agreed that it would become binding (ie, take effect) only if the builder's other pending bid was rejected - a condition precedent to effectiveness. Therefore, the parol evidence rule does not bar evidence of the oral agreement to prove that the contract failed to take effect because the builder's other pending bid was accepted (Choice D). Accordingly, the homeowner cannot recover for the builder's nonperformance because the builder's performance never became due.


(Choice A) Efficiency principles justify (but do not excuse) a breach if it is more economically advantageous for a party to breach and pay damages than to perform. But the builder did not breach the contract, and even if he had, the facts do not indicate that it was economically advantageous for him to do so.


(Choice C) An illusory promise is one so vague that the promisor has discretion whether to perform. Here, the builder's promise was not illusory because he was obligated to perform if his pending bid was rejected.


Educational objective: Evidence used to establish a condition precedent that must occur before a contract becomes effective is admissible under the parol evidence rule.

正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

parol evidence rule 的例外情况


在先或同期的口头或书面协议的证据可以被采纳，以证明：



  • 书面文件是否为一份整合合同，以及如果是，是完全整合还是部分整合

  • 模糊条款的含义

  • 合同成立或执行的抗辩（例如，欺诈、胁迫、错误）

  • 批准或拒绝救济的理由（例如，撤销、修正）

  • 后续的合同修改

  • 合同生效的先决条件


parol evidence rule 通常禁止使用在先或同期的协议证据来修改或反驳整合书面文件的条款。但当一方当事人攻击协议的有效性时——例如，主张存在一个未发生的合同生效先决条件——此规则不适用。因此，关于此类生效先决条件的证据是可采纳的。


在本案中，合同签署前，双方口头约定，只有在建筑商的另一项待决投标被拒绝的情况下，合同才具有约束力（即生效）——这是一个合同生效的先决条件。因此，parol evidence rule 不会禁止采纳该口头协议的证据，以证明由于建筑商的另一项待决投标被接受，该合同未能生效 （选项D）。因此，房主不能因建筑商的不履行行为获得赔偿，因为建筑商的履行义务从未到期。


（选项A）如果一方当事人违约并支付损害赔偿金比履行合同在经济上更有利，效率原则可以为该违约行为提供正当性理由（但不能免除其责任）。但建筑商并未违约，即使他违约了，案件事实也未表明这样做对他来说在经济上是有利的。


（选项C）虚幻允诺指承诺内容含糊不清，以至于允诺人可以自行决定是否履行。在本案中，建筑商的承诺并不是虚幻的，因为如果他的待决投标被拒绝，他就有义务履行。


教学目的：根据 parol evidence rule，用于证明合同生效前必须发生的先决条件的证据是可采纳的。




References



Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 217 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (integrated agreement subject to oral requirement).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Parol Evidence Rule
核心考点：口头证据规则的例外

本题考察的是合同法中著名的 Parol Evidence Rule (口头证据规则) 的一个关键例外：
Condition Precedent to Effectiveness
(合同生效的先决条件)

法律规则解析

一般原则：
如果双方签署了一份完全整合的书面合同（Integrated Writing），通常禁止引入任何在签署前或签署时的口头协议来改变或反驳书面条款。

关键例外（本题考点）：
但是，如果一方主张该口头协议是“合同生效的前提条件”，则该证据可以被采纳。

逻辑链条：
如果先决条件（Condition Precedent）未发生
→ 合同从未生效 (Not Effective)
→ 既然合同未生效，就不存在违约责任。
本案分析
  • 口头约定：只有在另一投标被拒（Condition）时，才会为房主工作。
  • 书面合同：虽然签署了，但未提及此条件。
  • 结果：另一投标被接受了 → 条件未满足（Condition failed）。

因为条件未满足，该书面合同从未产生法律效力。因此，建筑商没有履行的义务（Duty to perform）。

选项深度辨析

✅ 选项 B (正确)
"No, because the builder's duty to perform was subject to a condition."
建筑商的履行义务受限于一个条件。由于该条件（另一投标被拒）未发生，履行义务从未被激活。

❌ 选项 D (常见陷阱)
"Yes, because the parol evidence rule would bar..."
这是最具迷惑性的选项。考生容易机械地认为“有书面合同 + 之前的口头约定 = PER 禁止”。
切记：当口头证据是用来证明“合同是否生效”时，PER 不适用。

❌ 选项 A (效率违约)
"Efficiency principles..."
效率违约（Efficient Breach）理论解释了为什么违约在经济上可能是合理的，但它不能免除违约方的赔偿责任。如果合同有效且被违约，建筑商仍需赔偿，而不是完全免责。

❌ 选项 C (虚幻允诺)
"Illusory..."
虚幻允诺是指一方拥有任意决定权（例如“如果我想做我就做”）。本案中，条件是基于外部事件（另一投标的结果），而非建筑商的主观意愿，因此不是虚幻的。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧

看到 "Written Contract"（书面合同）加上 "Oral Agreement"（口头协议），第一反应是 Parol Evidence Rule。

紧接着要问自己：这个口头协议是在解释合同、修改合同，还是在设定一个生效门槛？

如果是设定“只有发生X，合同才算数”（Condition Precedent to Effectiveness），那么该口头证据有效，且合同可能因条件未满足而无效。

D. Yes, because the usage of trade is offered to give meaning to the contract.

Under the UCC parol evidence rule, evidence of any prior agreement (or any contemporaneous oral agreement) cannot be used to contradict the terms of a final written agreement. But the following evidence can always be used to explain or supplement those terms, regardless of whether the terms appear ambiguous:†

  • Course of performance – sequence of conduct that is relevant to understanding an agreement between the parties if (1) the agreement involves repeated occasions for performance by a party and (2) the other party accepts performance without objection Course of dealing – sequence of conduct concerning previous transactions between the parties that establishes a common basis of understanding for interpreting their conduct Trade usage – any practice or method of dealing in the parties' business or industry that is practiced with enough regularity to justify an expectation that it will be practiced in the instant case


Therefore, the studio's evidence of an established practice in the studio industry to price cup-and-saucer sets on a per-piece (not a per-set) basis is admissible because it is offered to give meaning to the contract.

†Priority is given as follows: (1) express contract terms prevail over all others, (2) course of performance prevails over course of dealing and trade usage, and (3) course of dealing prevails over trade usage.

(Choice A) Even if the terms of a written contract appear unambiguous, the UCC allows a party to explain or supplement the terms by evidence of trade usage, course of dealing, or course of performance.

(Choice B) If the agreement was completely integrated (ie, intended as a final and complete statement of the parties' agreement), then the studio could not explain or supplement its terms with evidence of consistent additional terms. But integration has no effect on the studio's ability to do so with evidence of trade usage (or course of dealing or performance).

(Choice C) Evidence of trade usage is admissible only to explain or supplement (not contradict) the terms of a final written agreement.

Educational objective: The UCC parol evidence rule always allows use of the following evidence to explain or supplement the terms of a final written agreement: course of performance, course of dealing, and trade usage.



根据《统一商法典》(UCC)的口头证据规则，任何先前协议（或任何同期的口头协议）的证据不得用以抵触最终书面协议的条款。但以下证据始终可以用来解释或补充这些条款，无论这些条款表面上是否明确：†

  • 履约过程 (Course of performance) – 如果(1)协议涉及一方的重复履约机会，且(2)另一方无异议地接受履约，则与理解双方协议相关的一系列行为。 交易过程 (Course of dealing) – 双方之间先前交易的一系列行为，为解释其行为建立了共同的理解基础。 交易惯例 (Trade usage) – 在双方的商业或行业中的任何惯常做法或交易方法，其施行具有足够的规律性，以至于可以合理预期在本案中也会被遵守。


因此，工作室提出的关于工作室行业内杯碟套装按件（而非按套）计价的既定惯例的证据是可采纳的，因为这是为了解释合同的含义。

†优先顺序如下：(1) 明示合同条款优先于所有其他条款，(2) 履约过程优先于交易过程和交易惯例，以及(3) 交易过程优先于交易惯例。

(选项A) 即使书面合同的条款看起来明确无误，《统一商法典》仍允许一方通过交易惯例、交易过程或履约过程的证据来解释或补充这些条款。

(选项B) 如果协议是完全整合的（即意在作为双方协议的最终和完整陈述），那么工作室将不能用一致的附加条款的证据来解释或补充其条款。但整合对于工作室使用交易惯例（或交易过程、履约过程）的证据来这样做没有影响。

(选项C) 交易惯例的证据仅可用于解释或补充（而非抵触）最终书面协议的条款。

MBE 考点解析

Contracts / UCC Parol Evidence Rule
核心法律规则 (UCC § 2-202) 在《统一商法典》(UCC) 下，即使书面合同是完全整合 (Completely Integrated) 的，且条款表面上没有歧义 (Unambiguous)，依然允许引入以下三类外部证据来解释或补充合同条款：

Course of Performance (履约过程) Course of Dealing (交易过程) Usage of Trade (交易惯例)
正确答案：D

为什么选 D？

本题的核心在于交易惯例 (Usage of Trade) 的可采性。

虽然合同写着 "$5 each"（每个5美元）看起来非常明确，但在陶瓷行业（Studio Industry）中，这个词可能具有特殊的含义（即按单件计价，而非按套计价）。

UCC 采取了非常自由的立场：语言的含义取决于商业背景。因此，只要是为了“解释 (Explain)”或“补充 (Supplement)”合同条款，交易惯例的证据总是可采纳的，不需要先证明合同条款存在模棱两可（Ambiguity）的情况。

UCC 解释合同的优先顺位：
1. Express Terms (明示条款)
2. Course of Performance (履约过程)
3. Course of Dealing (交易过程)
4. Usage of Trade (交易惯例)
为什么 A 是错的？ (No, unambiguous...)

这是一个典型的普通法 (Common Law) 思维陷阱。在普通法下，通常需要先认定合同有歧义，才能引入外部证据。但在 UCC (货物买卖) 下，不需要证明条款有歧义即可引入交易惯例。

为什么 B 是错的？ (No, completely integrated...)

合并条款 (Merger Clause) 确实能阻止引入“一致的附加条款 (Consistent Additional Terms)”，但它不能阻止引入上述的三类解释性证据（履约过程、交易过程、交易惯例），除非合同中非常明确地排除了这些惯例的适用。

为什么 C 是错的？ (Yes, always...)

虽然方向对了，但表述太绝对。交易惯例证据不能用来“抵触 (Contradict)”明示条款。如果惯例与明示条款完全无法共存，明示条款胜出。本题中，证据是用来定义 "$5 each" 的含义，被视为“解释”而非“抵触”，所以 D 比 C 更准确。

💡 MBE 考试技巧：
看到 UCC (货物买卖) + Parol Evidence Rule (口头证据规则) 的题目时，请记住：UCC 极度偏爱商业背景。只要是 Usage of Trade, Course of Dealing, 或 Course of Performance，通常都是可采纳的，即使合同里有 Merger Clause，即使字面意思看起来很清楚。
